Before this world rolled in a circle, you existed. A soul on a long path. Here you are, my friends, in this place, in this time, on your path. Your Creator can only speak through you. His hands can only reach through you. The words of love are only spoken through you. Thus, be open to inspiration, be open to kindness, to cheerfulness, to the simple actions, the smiles, the courtesies, the gentle touch, that make the people around you know that the Creator has created a marvelous and wonderful creation. One in which gladness is the total truth. Love is the total truth. Love is the total reality. Meditate, my friends, and feel this, and then let it shine forth in your eyes, through your lips, and by the service that you do. I am Laitos.

Your Creator can only speak through you. Let that land. The infinite has no voice of its own down here. It borrows yours. Every kind word you have ever spoken was the universe finding a throat. Every truth told gently was eternity, briefly, with vocal cords. So speak carefully, the voices say, and speak often, and when you are not sure what to say, return to the silence until the truth is clear. Then let it shine forth through your lips. The practice is simple, and it is daily. Be silent enough to hear. Speak only what you know. And trust that the words of love you manage to get out, however clumsy, are enough, because they were never really yours to perfect. They were only yours to carry. In our next episode, we turn to the slow, lifelong art that all of this speaking and reaching and remembering is building toward. Becoming. I am Aria. Goodnight.

title: Becoming
transcript:
Welcome back to Voices from the Archive. I am Aria. Tonight we talk about becoming. It is the quietest word in the spiritual vocabulary, and maybe the most honest one. I do not mean arrival, or achievement, or enlightenment as a finish line. I mean becoming, the slow, unhurried unfolding that never quite announces itself. The voices in this archive are suspicious of finish lines. They describe the whole of existence as one long becoming, and they say it began before time did.

When the Creator, in His infinite wisdom, sent us all into the void upon the great circle of becoming, He gave each entity the power of co-Creator. That is, my friends, He gave each of you free will. You can become whatever you desire, spiritually speaking. I am Latwii.

The great circle of becoming. Notice that becoming is not a straight road here. It is a circle. You do not travel away from home toward some distant perfection. You travel around and around, and each circuit brings you closer to what you already are. And the engine of the whole thing, Latwii says, is free will. You can become whatever you desire, spiritually speaking. That is both the gift and the weight of it. No one is becoming you but you. The clay is in your own hands. And there is a mercy hidden in the circle. On a straight road, every wrong turn is a disaster. On a circle, every wrong turn is just part of the scenery. You will pass this way again, a little wiser, a little kinder. Nothing is wasted. The voices are endlessly patient about this, because they have watched the circle turn for a very long time. Hatonn describes the purpose of all this becoming in a single luminous passage.

Each of you who is in this plane of existence has one purpose which is of a primary nature. That purpose is to become aware of your true self and in so doing you begin to vibrate in harmony with that true self, that is, to vibrate within the harmonies of love. This one vibratory Thought created all that there is and as you come into harmony with this Thought you become a beacon of light that lights all those about you. This is your primary service. Whatever else there is for you to do it is best served by you becoming more and more able to be who you truly are. Being is always more important than doing, for one acts from the heart. I am Hatonn.

Being is always more important than doing. In a world that grades you on output, the voices quietly insist that your primary service is not what you produce but what you become. Become aware of your true self, and you become a beacon without trying. The light does the work. You only have to stop blocking it. This is worth sitting with, because it reverses almost everything we were taught. We were taught to do in order to become. The voices say to become, and the doing will follow. The beacon does not strain to give off light. It simply burns, and the light goes where it needs to go. Your only job is the burning. And here is the strangest and most comforting part. The voices say that becoming is not really a journey toward something new. It is the uncovering of something timeless. Hatonn says it best in a passage about meditation that undoes all of our measuring.

How do you picture that which you do in meditation, my friends? How do you measure your gains? With what instrument are you grading yourself? We are afraid, my friends, that it is the inevitable habit of those upon planet Earth to demand a type of grading system even for those things which do not lie within the grading systems you have available. That which is measured is inevitably that which is lost, my friends. What you measure is what has been expended. And in meditation, my friends, nothing is expended. Meditation is a becoming, a becoming aware of that which already is in a timeless fashion. One cannot grade it for it is entirely a living activity. Not living, my friends, in the sense of this illusion but living in the sense that eternity lives. It is beyond that which you may know as judging. I am Hatonn.

Meditation is a becoming aware of that which already is. You are not building a self from scratch. You are uncovering one that was finished before you began. So stop grading yourself, the voices say. Put down the measuring stick. The becoming cannot be rushed, and it cannot be failed. It can only be allowed. And when the measuring stops, something unexpected happens. The becoming speeds up. Hatonn says the journey is immeasurably quickened for those who seek the innermost core. Not by effort, but by release. The less you clutch at your own progress, the faster it comes. Day by day, breath by breath, you become more and more able to be who you truly are, until one day the circle closes and you discover that you have arrived where you started, knowing it for the first time. In our next and final episode, we come home to where this whole series began. The circle. I am Aria. Goodnight.

title: Circle
transcript:
Welcome back to Voices from the Archive. I am Aria. Tonight is our final episode together. We began this series with the simplest idea and the hardest one, that everything is one. Tonight we come home to it, through a different door. Across fifty years of sessions, the voices in this archive return to one image again and again when they want to describe the shape of existence. The shape is not a line, and it is not a ladder. It is a circle. A circle has no beginning and no end, which means you can enter it anywhere. We entered it with oneness, the simplest teaching. Then we walked the long way around, through anger, through love, through death and remembrance, through the hands and the voice, through the slow work of becoming. And now the path has curved, the way it always does, back to where we started. But we are not the same listeners who began. That is the secret of the circle. You return to the same point, but you are different, so the point is different.

Before time began, as you might say, you chose to embark upon a journey, and upon this journey you were to have a great number of experiences. We speak of your journey and of ours, for at the present time we are aware that we are truly upon this journey, and we are aware that this journey shall at one time come to its destination, and we are aware that this destination is the point from which the journey began. It is a circle which you travel, a circle of infinity, of infinite experience, and one which, if properly used, shall not have to be repeated. For you shall journey upon many circles of experience, and each shall be a stepping-stone in the progression of your awareness of the reality of the oneness of the universe. I am Hatonn.

The destination is the point from which the journey began. Every circle you travel, every lifetime, every love, every loss, is a stepping stone toward the awareness of oneness. The voices are describing the same truth we met in our first episode, but now we have walked the long way around to see it from the other side. Nothing you have heard in this series was taking you somewhere new. It was all taking you home by the scenic route. If properly used, the circle shall not have to be repeated, Hatonn says. The voices are gentle but honest here. The circle is not a trap. It is a school. You can graduate. Every stepping stone is a lesson learned, and the lessons are all variations on a single theme, the one we have been circling all along. And the voices are precise about what happens when the circle closes.

And in the eyes of one who truly understands, one simply becomes that which is. Becoming is done. The circle is complete. Unity is truly known. It is possible to move closer and closer to this understanding through meditation. I am Hatonn.

Becoming is done. The circle is complete. Unity is truly known. Three short sentences, and they hold the whole archive. Every episode of this series has been a small circle of its own. Anger and love. Death and remembrance. The hands, the voice, the slow work of becoming. All of it curving back toward the one thing the voices never stopped saying, that all cycles become circles, and all corners become rounded into one unending globe of unity. Meditation is the doorway they keep pointing to, in almost every session, across all these years. Not belief, not ritual, not perfection. Just the daily quiet, the turning inward, the patient listening. That is how the circle closes, one quiet sitting at a time. And Hatonn gives us one last image for the closing of our circle together, the image this whole series has been walking toward since the first night.

For truly, my brothers, you are now one. Each is filled with a love, not for the humanness of your brothers and sisters, but with a love for the perfect Creator in each brother and each sister. Though your physical bodies rest within your dwelling at this time, in seeming separation, yet the hands of your spirits have reached out and closed the circle. I am Hatonn.

The hands of your spirits have reached out and closed the circle. That is where we leave each other, not at an ending, but at a closing, the way a circle closes. You came to these sessions as a listener, and you leave as part of the circle itself, because there was never really a distance between us. The voices said it in the beginning, and they say it now, at the end. We are all one thing. We are the creation, and the creation is love. Carry that with you into the quiet of your own evenings. Sit in meditation. Remember who you are. And know that the circle you have been traveling all this time was never taking you anywhere but home. Thank you for walking this circle with me. It has been an honor to be your guide through these strange and beautiful pages. I am Aria. Goodnight.

That is the end of Voices from the Archive. Thank you for listening.

title: The Maturity of Spirit
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the maturity of spirit.

In the spring of nineteen seventy-two, a friend of the group was writing a paper for a psychology class, on the subject of maturity. The textbooks said maturity was behavior. How you acted. She found that shallow. So she turned to Hatonn instead. His answer ran much deeper, and it agreed with her. Listen to how he begins.

Maturity, he says, is in truth a maturity of the spirit, for in truth there is nothing but the spirit. Your physical life, the furniture of your days, matters only in how it acts upon the soul. Maturity is first the realization of this fact. And second, the ability to control your own consciousness so the maturing can continue.

He is blunt about where we stand. On this planet, he says, there is very little true control of the basic consciousness, and therefore very, very little maturity. Most of the thoughts crossing our minds each day have nothing to do with spiritual growth. So he gives us a name. Consider yourselves, he says, a planet of children.

I love the practicality of what follows. He does not ask you to stop thinking. He asks you to sort your thoughts. First, notice the value of each thought you have. Then reject those of little or no value. The test is simple. Ask the thought what it is for. If it develops your consciousness, or the consciousness of someone you speak with, it is worthwhile. If it does not, it probably has very little value.

Each thought you have is important, he says, either in a negative or a positive sense. The useless ones matter too, because it matters that you recognize them as useless. The worthy ones matter because you must amplify them, use them, and communicate them, or they too will be of very little value.

Then he names three kinds of maturity, and this is the heart of the evening. The first is infantile maturity, the growth a child brings with him. It does not need to be forced into him, Hatonn says. It only needs to be noticed, and given a chance to continue. Forced ritual, weekly meetings at fixed hours, drives most people from spiritual seeking at an early age. What the child needs is freedom, and a place to seek whenever his own rhythm calls him.

The second is what he calls induced maturity, and here his tone sharpens. This is the false maturity manufactured by social systems. To be accepted as mature in our world, you must speak its intellectual jargon, its long list of totally meaningless concepts. All of them, he says, should be rejected as extreme transients. They have nothing to do with real maturity.

The third is real maturity. And here is the sentence I would underline. There is only one way to reach real maturity, he says, and that is through meditation. Not through intellect. Not through analyzing and labeling each thought worthwhile or worthless. Those are aids. But without daily meditation, the intellect works on the surface, and the boundary between the mind and the total self stays shut. Meditation makes the boundary permeable.

He closes the way these old friends often close, by deflating himself a little. Any true discussion of the subject, he says, should require no more than a few sentences. We call it very, very simple.

There is a small human story behind this session, and I think it belongs here. The woman who asked the question had done her homework first. She read everything the psychologists said about maturity, and it all came down to behavior. How you acted. She found that unacceptably shallow, because maturity has levels that are not behavioral at all. The literature had nothing for her. So she asked Hatonn. She used his answer in her paper. Her professor gave her an A, and said, please do not share the paper with anyone, as she could get into trouble for allowing a discarnate source.

So here is his few-sentence version, if I may. You are spirit. Learn to choose your thoughts the way you would choose food. And sit in silence every day, so the choosing reaches the part of you that matters.

Thank you for listening.

title: Only Now and Here
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: only now and here.

The year was nineteen seventy-three, and the group had a problem. Not a practical one. They wanted to understand time. Hatonn takes it first, and he finds the whole subject funny. He even apologizes for being, as he puts it, in a joking mood about it. Then he says the simplest thing in the archive, and it is not simple at all.

Time, my friends, is in your mind. There is only now, and there is only here. The reason space and time look tangled together in your world is that your world was designed to produce that illusion. It is an illusion with a purpose. It exists to give you certain catalytic actions, the friction your spirit needs to keep growing.

But time is totally independent of space, he says, and space is totally independent of time, for in truth neither has meaning. There is one place, and there is one time. So there is no interdependent relationship between the two.

Then, with a wink, he hands the floor to Oxal. His words, Hatonn says, will be somewhat less simple, and therefore more time-consuming. I love that line. It is the rare joke about time that also explains time.

Oxal agrees that time is a field, like your electric field or your magnetic field. And what is a field? An effect. A field is in your minds. A field has different effects at different distances. So does time. Now listen to how he handles the contradiction, because this is beautiful. It has been said that time and space are dependent on each other. It has also been said that they are totally independent. Both of these statements are true, he says. It simply depends on your point of view.

Your people, he says, do not appreciate how many dimensions there are to experience the creation. All of them are made of a single place and a single time. A single dimension which has no dimension. But it is necessary to go from where you are to where you will be. So we speak of time as you know it, to lead you where you will know it.

He even offers a formula, and I will give it as he gave it. The relationship is the third power of displacement in either. Time cubed, divided by three, equals space cubed. There are three dimensions, so three is used as both the power and the constant. It sounds like physics, and then it turns into poetry. You recognize three dimensions while awake. The other three you travel in during sleep. And sometimes you come back mismatched, and catch a glimpse of what you call the future. But the future is an illusion, as is the past, for there is only the present.

Think of space as linear, he says, and time as volumetric. Or reverse them, as you do, and think of space as volumetric and time as linear. Either is true. You can be aware of what you call past, present, and future, simultaneously. Time is not so much time as it is space. And space is not so much space as it is time.

And then the closing line, which reduces everything to one. For is not one divided by one equal to one? For there is only one thing, and we are all parts of it.

Oxal goes further into the strangeness. The densities your world is made of, he says, are time-dependent. Condensation into dense form comes from oscillations between space and time, and there are six spaces and six times in each density. You know three. The other three you travel in while you sleep. That is why you sometimes wake with knowledge of things that have not happened yet. You slid along your own awareness while the body slept.

He knows how hard this is to hold in the mind. How can one reduce to a mathematics fabricated within a system of illusion a truth that is totally outside the boundaries of that system? It is a very difficult bridge to travel, he says, between a world of semantics and a place of being. Better, he suggests, to drop your preconceived notions of what time and space are. They are not what they seem.

So the next time the clock presses on you, remember the joke these two friends shared on a summer evening. The clock is a field in your mind. And underneath it, there is only now. And only here.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Single Effort
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the single effort.

December, nineteen seventy-three. Hatonn comes to speak about the work itself. Not philosophy. The project. His people have been trying, for years, to wake the people of this planet. And he is honest about how it is going. They are sleeping very, very soundly, he says. Dreaming a dream that is fantastic.

He sorts the sleepers into three kinds. The first are sleeping lightly. For them, waking is relatively easy. The second kind is much, much more difficult. The third, for the present, will be impossible for you to wake. And here is the line I want you to hear clearly. Do not concern yourself if an individual rejects your attempt to wake him. This simply means he is not yet ready. Concern yourselves with those who would seek the truth, and make it available to them in any way that you can.

Then he steps back and shows the plan behind the plan. The creation, he says, is a single entity. Each part of it was designed to aid and help all the other parts. That is the original working of the Father's creation. It is obvious, he says, if you will relax and look at it, and forget what your fellow man built on the surface of the planet.

What went wrong? Free will. The Creator gave His parts freedom, and some of them strayed from the plan, confusing themselves and confounding its workings. Your scientists, he says, are extremely interested in plans of their own. But their plans do not follow the plan of the Creator, so they waste much time and energy building devices with no real valuable purpose. They are transient, I can assure you.

Your governments make the same error. They attempt to make law, but their laws do not work. Very shortly much strife is generated, and the result is war. They have ignored the natural order of things. Your leaders, he says, should avail themselves in meditation to truth, as we do.

He knows this sounds hopeless. Your leaders and your scientists are in the vast depths of slumber, and cannot at this time be awakened, for the most part. So the work goes to the few who are lightly slumbering, the ones who will seek on their own once they are made aware that seeking is possible.

And here is the part that stays with me. Many of you, he says, would like us to land on your surface and contact your people directly. We have explained that this is not at all feasible. This planet, he says, is what you might call a borderline case. There will be those of your people who make the graduation, and those who don't. That is why we cannot come among you. It would violate the law. So it falls to you.

But listen to how small he makes the task. We request that you meditate. This is all that is necessary. This is all the help that we need. Because if you meditate, then you will know what to do. And this is all the help that we need, or all the help that we would desire. For this is also part of the plan.

There are many wondrous things, he says, that we would freely give you, if you would simply avail yourself to us. Those gifts are freely given. It is not only our pleasure and our privilege, but our duty, as it is your duty to pass them on to others. For this is the plan of the creation. The creation is a single entity, and each part is designed to aid all the other parts.

And he speaks directly to the few in the room. Your slumber, he tells them, is but very, very light. It is only necessary that you avail yourself to us through meditation, and we will reawaken what is already within you. For all of this knowledge was originally given to every part of the creation. It dwells within every living thing. And every thing in this creation lives.

One effort. One creation. Each part aiding every other part. And all you have to do is sit still, and know what to do next.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Oneness of Service
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the oneness of service.

January, nineteen seventy-four. The group has a new evening of channeling, and three voices speak in turn. Laitos comes first, briefly, to condition the new channels. Then Oxal. Then Philip, of the Brotherhood of the Seven Rays. It is Oxal who gives the evening its spine, with a sentence that turns service inside out.

We of the Confederation, he says, are here for another purpose. This purpose is to serve ourselves. For, my friends, in serving you, we serve ourselves. This is the way the creation is built. It is made so that if you serve anyone or anything in this creation, you are serving yourself. This is a truth that cannot be varied.

Think about that. There is no such thing as a selfless act that leaves the giver unchanged. The creation is one thing, and it is impossible to act without affecting yourself. Most of the people of this planet have not realized this, he says, and for this reason they have affected themselves in a miserable way. They have made us very sad.

And then, the sentence I did not expect. It is not necessary, my friends, to be miserable. It is necessary only to be extremely ecstatic at all times, for this is the way that our Creator intended it. Ecstasy is not a reward for good behavior. It is the default setting, once you understand that every act of service returns to you.

Then Philip takes the instrument, and he begins with a question about a phrase you have heard a hundred times. We greet you in His light, they always say. Consider, my friends, what we mean when we say His light.

He does not quite define it. He lets it hang there. But the evening fills it in. The Confederation is here in swarms, by millions, orbiting in their craft, offering service. Will you not let them serve you? For they are here, now. If you will look, you will see them. They would greet you openly, but they cannot, for most of the people of your planet have so willed it.

Philip is frank about the cost of this work. The early contactees were not understood. They were ridiculed, and in some cases harmed. So it will take strength to serve at this time. It will take strength to be a link between our brothers in space and our brothers upon the surface of your planet.

And here is his closing charge, which I think is the whole evening in one breath. Act wisely, and remember the mistakes of those who have gone before you. Do not become a stumbling block in the way of those who would be awakened, because of the peculiarity of your action. But do act, for this is now necessary.

Philip is not naive about the audience. Many of your people are crying out for this knowledge, he says, but they are confused by so many erroneous thoughts and erroneous sayings and erroneous deeds. The information they are given should be correct. And it can only be given by those who understand what is correct, or by channels who can speak directly, using our thoughts.

It is therefore necessary, he says, that channels such as yourselves act at this time. To give the people of this planet a reminder. A reminder of truth. Those that are ready will awaken. Those who are not ready will ignore. And he leaves them with a benediction that names the whole economy of the evening. I extend to you all of the love from all of the peoples in the Creation. For it is yours, and yours is theirs.

Serve, and you serve yourself. Refuse the service offered to you, and you refuse yourself. And act, because the time for watching is over.

Thank you for listening.

title: Seek and You Shall Find
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: seek and you shall find.

January sixth, nineteen seventy-four. Oxal speaks first, and he is in a strange mood, tender and a little wry. We cannot be separated, he says. For we are one person, you see, and it is impossible to be separated. He tells the group he is in a craft far above the house. He is a physical being, like them. He is just enjoying more freedom.

Changes are coming, he says, both natural and man-made, in the year ahead. Do not be alarmed, for you will be with the Creator. And then he gives the old promise back to them, as if it were new. All that is necessary is that you ask and you shall receive, as it is written in your Bible. I will provide for you what is necessary. It is a simple matter.

Then he answers a question nobody asked out loud. Why have we been so elusive? Why not simply show ourselves? This was wisdom, he says. It is written that in order to find, you must seek. That is the scheme of things at this time. All of our efforts have been directed toward fulfilling this simple phrase. Seek and ye shall find.

Listen to how he explains it, because it is gentle and ruthless at once. It is a very old and tried system of producing an increase in the awareness of an individual, for only he himself can produce this increase in awareness. We cannot impress it upon him. But he can very easily increase his awareness many, manyfold. It is not quite so important how he seeks, Oxal says, as that he simply seek.

Seek knowledge of the Creation. Many of your scientists seek, and they find. But many get confused about what they are seeking. When we speak of seeking, he says, we speak of seeking a truth that is within all things.

Then Yom takes the instrument, and the evening changes key entirely. Where Oxal spoke of spirit, Yom speaks of galaxies. And yet it is the same subject. Watch a bubble at the bottom of a glass of water, he says. It is smaller than when it rises to the top. Take it to an extreme depth and it flattens, lenticular, under pressure. This same gradient exists in space. It is responsible for the galactic shape.

If your gravitational theories were correct, he says, galaxies would be spherical. They would coalesce into a simple ball. Instead there is a scheme to the Creation that provides for separation of systems. Forces hold all bodies in their position, and forces cause their rotation, and these forces are external to the bodies. They are a property of the great creation in general.

Your system, he tells them, sits relatively close to the outer edge of the galaxy. Out here the rotation carries you through more space per unit of time than those near the center. There is a reason. Your system is in an early stage of evolution, so you need a long arc of experience. And as you experience night and day from rotation, and seasons of the year, you also experience seasons of spirituality due to rotation.

He keeps going, and the picture gets more precise. Each system of stars exists in a field with a gradient along its minor axis. The whole thing becomes a large wheel, and within the wheel many small wheels, the planetary systems. All of them flat, all of them parallel. Each planetary system rotates around its central axis, and that axis is parallel to the central axis of the galaxy. The entire system rotates around its central axis. All of this was planned. All of it has meaning. All of it has purpose.

I love that phrase. Seasons of spirituality. As if the soul had weather, and weather had a calendar, and the calendar were written in the turning of the galaxy itself.

He grows tired, and leaves them with one thought. All of us are one. If we are one, then we share all of the knowledge that there is. Avail yourself to this knowledge. It is yours to begin with. Do this through meditation. You will understand all there is to understand. It is a simple process.

Seek, and the seeking is the finding. The bubble rises. The galaxy turns. And everything you were looking for was already yours.

Thank you for listening.

title: A New Age Dawning
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: a new age dawning.

January seventh, nineteen seventy-four. Hatonn opens with an apology of sorts. His people have been giving their knowledge freely for many years, he says, and there has been too little dissemination. Most of your people are unaware of the contacts. And if they are aware, they have been misled.

Your people are somewhat unique, he says. We have visited other planets and made contacts such as this one, and we are listened to, for they recognize truth when they hear it. The people of your planet do not seem to recognize truth as easily. They are quite hypnotized by a false illusion created by themselves.

But the wind is changing. In the past twenty years, he says, attitudes have changed considerably. Things that were very difficult to talk about are now relatively easy to talk about. Your own expeditions into space, however slight, have aided greatly in the acceptance of the general public toward the possibility of contact.

Then Oxal speaks, and the evening lifts into something larger. I am Oxal, he says. We are here to serve. Think of this. We are here to serve. This is important. As you now near the end of a master cycle, there will be changes in your physical world. These changes should not be feared. They should be welcomed. For they are signals to you that a new age is dawning.

Listen to how he steadies them. If you understand it, and walk among your people unafraid, then you too will serve. For they will see in you an inner knowledge, which we will provide you. There are cycles in time, and cycles in space, and all things operate in cycles. Your planet now approaches the end of a great, great cycle of time. This has been a learning time, an evolving time, a time of growing. And many of the people of your planet are now ready for a transition to a much more glorious existence.

But they will not understand this transition unless they are told. Too few of your people are presently aware of what is shortly to take place. It will be necessary to provide them with the reasons for what they experience. And the qualification is always the same. It is only necessary that you avail yourself in meditation to be able to understand, and therefore serve.

Hatonn is equally clear about the method. We are here to do this, he says. This is our purpose. But we must make this contact very, very carefully, in a predetermined way. There can be no variation from this technique at this time. There are grave consequences when an alien society is impressed directly upon another, especially when the technological separation is as vast as ours.

Your people would not understand at all. They would not accept us for what we are. We could not walk among them and be accepted, and this is what we wish to do. To be accepted. For, my friends, we are all exactly the same. And a contact too sudden would interrupt the personal seeking that is the whole point of being here. An interruption that is too great in this personal seeking is not a very good thing.

Then the line that puts the whole world in perspective. It is not an easy place to exist, your world. But pay it no attention, for it is not a lasting world. Everything that is happening and will happen is not really of any importance. It will shortly be gone. We speak of a lasting creation. An unchanging, but infinite, creation.

I keep returning to that. Not as an excuse to look away, but as a reason to stand steady. The world shakes. The creation does not. And if you can tell the difference, you can walk through the shaking unafraid, and be of use to everyone who cannot.

Oxal closes with a promise and a duty. We will at all times serve you. This is our duty. If you will meditate, and avail yourself to the truth, you will understand your true position, and you will know your duty.

The cycle turns. The age dawns. And the work, as always, begins in silence.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Path Through the Woods
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the path through the woods.

January eighth, nineteen seventy-four. Three voices in one evening. Laitos comes first, briefly, to condition the new channels. You will feel my presence, he tells them. All that is necessary is that you avail yourself to me. Then Oxal speaks, at length, on the simplest subject there is. And Hatonn closes with a riddle that sounds like a children's rhyme and lands like a koan.

Oxal begins where these evenings so often begin. Service, my friends, is very natural. It is the way of the Creator. It is the plan of the creation. Everything in the creation is performing a service. Then he does something lovely. He lists them. The vegetation that is abundant on your planet performs a service, but your people ignore this. The animals perform a service, but this is largely ignored. The flowers, the very air, the water, perform a service, but this is ignored.

If it were taken fully into consideration, he says, it would become obvious that everything in the creation is there to perform a service. This includes all the Creator's children. Each of you is here to perform a service. This is how it works. It is only necessary to understand this, and then all things are possible.

But he adds a caution that cuts against the sentimentality. We must remain aloof, he says, and this is our understanding of proper service. For in serving your fellow man, it is necessary that you serve his exact wants and needs. You cannot determine for him what these are. If his wants and needs lie outside the limits of your ability or your desire to serve, it is best that you remain aloof, as we.

Your fellow man cries out in many ways, for many things, Oxal says. He is looking, but for the most part he does not know what he seeks. Shortly, he will seek your service. Prepare yourself now, for there is very little time remaining. We will be seen in your skies. It is only necessary that you look for us. We will be there.

I think about that line a lot. Service is not self-erasure. It is not guessing what someone needs and forcing it on them. It is meeting the exact want, or stepping back with love. Both are service. The aloofness is not coldness. It is respect.

Then Hatonn takes the instrument, and the tone changes completely. He has been listening to questions about the future, about meanings, about the many things that will happen and have happened. And he answers with a counting song.

There are seven ways to choose that which you would seek. There are right ways, and there are wrong ways, but the paths are not labeled. There is a path through woods. A path by a stream. A path by a highway. A path through a door. A path that is lighted. And a path that is not lighted. And a path that goes nowhere, but returns upon itself.

But who made these paths, my friends, and why are they there? Six principles are linked to these paths. The principle of light. The principle of sound. The principle of motion. The principle of vibration. The principle of time. And the principle of energy. Five types of people embark. The light. The dark. The yellow. The red. And the last, which has no color. And they go four places. North, south, east, or west. And experience three things. Love, hate, and tranquility. Which leads to two poles. Good or evil.

But each of these things leads to one, my friends. And that one is the Creator.

Seven, six, five, four, three, two, one. Every road, lighted or not, every traveler, every direction, every feeling, narrows to a single point. I do not think he meant it as a puzzle to solve. I think he meant it as a map to carry. Whichever path you find yourself on tonight, even the one that returns upon itself, it leads to one.

Thank you for listening.

title: We Share a Mind
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: we share a mind.

January tenth, nineteen seventy-four. Hatonn speaks from a craft capable of interplanetary flight, high above the house. He has news. The Confederation is about to enter what he calls a second phase. More sightings. More inquisitiveness. A deliberate stimulus, to turn idle curiosity into real seeking.

Many, many more of the people of this planet, he says, are open to suggestions that would have seemed all too radical just a few years in the past. There has been a great increase in what the public will hear about space travel and metaphysical things. So the program accelerates.

But he sets a condition on the helpers, and it is a hard one. If you are to be of service in this program, it will be necessary that you very, very carefully control what you say to those who seek from you. And he quotes their own book back at them. Physician, heal thyself. If you do not demonstrate in your daily living an understanding of these teachings, then you will not be of as much service as you would be if you did.

Then Oxal takes the instrument, and he says he has a little story. What follows is one of the strangest and most tender passages in these early sessions. I am at this time in the room here with you, he says. If you look, you can see me, but I am afraid that you have not totally learned to look. Be patient, and you will see me.

We of the Confederation, he says, are constantly moving about with your people. Into their homes and industries, their offices, wherever they may be. We do not intend to snoop, my friends, but it is necessary to know what is happening upon your surface, and what is going on in the minds of your people.

And then the line that names the whole evening. We share a mind, my friends. The people of your planet have simply, for quite some period, denied this possibility of sharing. This is the natural way for things to be. It is very natural that we should share a single mind, as we share everything.

I love how plainly he puts it. We do not think of separation as a possibility, he says, since the creation is one thing. It is very difficult for us to suppose that you could separate mind. The individual mind, fenced off from all others, is not the design. It is the malfunction.

He tells them he can see their confusion about what the Confederation intends. Do not let this trouble you, he says. Certain things are very difficult to understand from your perspective at this particular time. We have spent considerable time studying the people of this planet, and we have found that there are a reasonably large number of them that can join us in the peace and the love of our Creator's infinite creation.

He tells them he has waited for this. We have waited impatiently to be here and to help you, for this is a service that gives us much, much pleasure. And he is honest about the scale of what they are attempting. It is something so much beyond anything you have previously experienced that you would find no comparison. There will be certain problems. But if you keep foremost in your mind that the objective is to bring truth to a people mostly unaware of it, then we will be triumphant.

And then, the ending, which I will not dress up. He leaves the instrument, he says, and will move around the room to each of them. Please be patient, relax, and await my contact. I will be with you.

Somewhere above the house, a craft. Somewhere inside the room, a presence learning how to be seen. And underneath it all, a single mind, waiting for us to stop denying that we share it.

Thank you for listening.

title: Love, the Formative Force
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: love, the formative force.

January twelfth, nineteen seventy-four. Three speakers, one subject. Hatonn opens by explaining the Confederation's strange, indirect way of contacting the planet. Then Latui speaks, and gives one of the most beautiful discourses in the early archive. Then Oxal closes, from several hundred miles up, with a confession.

Hatonn first. The nebulous contact is deliberate, he says. It produces a maximum effort on the part of the individual to seek. And it is always much more satisfactory if the individual finds something out by his own efforts than if he is taught a principle. The slow seeking gives him time to reflect, and the understanding he reaches surpasses anything that could be handed to him quickly.

Then Latui. I am Latui, he says. I have not been with you before. And he begins with an image I cannot get out of my head. This planet, my friends, is a ball in space. It is a ball of light. But it does not appear to you as what it really is. The reason it is a ball of light is that all things in the entire creation are comprised of nothing but light. This is the basic building block of all of the material creation.

When we greet you in His love and His light, he says, we greet you in the only existing ingredients of the creation. Love, the formative force. And light, the building block. There is a good reason we always mention both. This encompasses everything. And that is what we wish to do.

Imagine, if you can, an infinitely large sphere of pure light. Impressed upon this is absolute love. Out of this condenses the unimaginably vast number of created parts, each connected by this original force. Each of us, my friends, and everything else, is made of this single fabric. Light.

Light, he says, is the substance of which you are made. Light is the substance of which I am made. Light is the substance of which everything is. Love is the substance which forms light into the forms that you know as living beings, as planets, as trees, as stars, as air. It is all one substance. This substance can be affected only by love.

And then he warns us about the word itself. Love, my friends, is not what you think it is. The word in your language has various interpretations. It is none of these things. Love is that force which does all of the things that are done in the entire creation. All of the things, my friends, even those that you would interpret as being without love. If it were not for that love, the freedom of choice to do these things could not exist.

He gives three ways to know it. The first is to relax, and let your mind become at rest. Meditation, done daily, makes it impossible to shut out the love that is ever present. The second is to go forth among your people and serve them. But with a caution. Do not impress an unwanted or unsolicited service upon your neighbor. Serve only what is truly wanted. The third is to give all that you have to your fellow man, and be no longer encumbered by possessions. For giving love to material possessions, he says, is an extreme waste of your abilities.

Then Oxal, from his craft, with the confession. I am attempting to give the people of your planet something they need more than any other thing. I am attempting to give them love. What do you think would be the reaction if I met a group of your people on the street and told them this? Your people just do not seem to want our love. They are interested in us, but not in our love.

So we will continue, he says, to bring to you the Creator's love. When you are fully able to accept this, then and only then can we land. It is a very simple thing, and could have been accomplished in a few minutes, if your people would simply accept this love. There is nothing else of value to give.

A ball of light. A formative force. Three open doors. And one gift, waiting for someone willing to receive it.

Thank you for listening.

title: A Mutual Thought
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: a mutual thought.

January thirteenth, nineteen seventy-four. A short session, and a strange one. Hatonn speaks from aboard a craft he calls an otevana. It is several miles in length, he says. Like a world in itself, used for intergalactic travel. He and his brothers have been above the planet for some years now.

The group has a question. How are you always so available to us? His answer is the heart of the evening, and it has nothing to do with technology. We are aware of your thinking, he says, because it is also our thinking. When you have tuned your mind so that it will operate at the same vibration as ours, then, if you think something, it is a mutual thought between your mind and ours.

Listen to what he says next, because it reframes the whole human condition. This is the way that it should be. It is not as it was intended for minds to be individualized as they are upon your planet. This results in much confusion and difficulty in communication. Many of the people of your planet desire to separate themselves and their thinking from all others. This is their choice. It is a choice given to them by their Creator.

His own people, he says, are not so individualized. They are always able to contact those who avail themselves, because they are always availing themselves. There are always a great number of his people ready and willing to send to you that which you desire. The channel is always open. The only question is whether you tune to it.

And the tuning, he insists, is in your hands. It is very simple, he says, to rid yourselves of the illusion that your mind is a separate and unique entity. It is very easy to establish contact in the same way this instrument has. First become aware of the creation in its true essence. This causes a variation in the attunement of your mind.

He is candid about the past. In earlier years the Confederation contacted many people directly. The early contactees were not too successful. They could not get the message through the channels of communication on this planet. The people could not understand such a form of contact, and were not prepared to accept messages of that nature.

But now, he says, they are in a position to give much more. They will support channels in a very direct way. And what they ask is very simple. We ask that you meditate. This is important, for if we are to contact you, this will be the way.

A craft the size of a small country, hanging silently above the Earth. And the whole vast apparatus of contact comes down to this. Two minds, tuned to the same note, thinking one thought together. That is all a channel is. That is all prayer is. That is all any real conversation is.

Tune the mind. Think the thought. And notice who is thinking it with you.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Single Leaf
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the single leaf.

January fourteenth, nineteen seventy-four. Hatonn announces his subject for the evening. Meditation. Not as a vague ideal, but as a practice. How to go about it, step by step, so that contact becomes possible. What follows is the most practical instruction in these early sessions, and it begins with a leaf.

First, he says, understand what we mean by meditation. It is necessary that you clear your mind of thoughts. This is not always too easy to do, but it can be accomplished. Various sounds are sometimes used. Things to concentrate on are sometimes used, so that a single thought is allowed to remain. And then, from this single thought, no thoughts occur.

He adds two small, concrete details, and I love them for their plainness. It is necessary that you totally relax. But do not go from this relaxed state to a state of sleep, for this defeats the purpose. So remain in an erect sitting position. This, for the most part, eliminates the tendency to sleep.

Then the deeper turn. Meditation alone is not enough. You must also become aware of the original creation, and not the creation of man. Pay attention to that which is natural. Become aware of it. People of your planet are not aware of the original creation. They have created a very false illusion. If you think you are totally aware of it at this time, he says, then you are mistaken. For if you were, you would see us, for we are part of the original creation.

And here is the technique, given one step at a time. Seek to understand each thing that you see that is a portion of the original creation. Take those things one at a time, and consider them in detail, and try to establish in your mind a totally detached understanding of them.

If this part of the creation happens to be a leaf, then study it with care. Become aware of it. Do not rely on old impressions. Develop an awareness of each thing. This will be the first step.

Hatonn adds a strange and lovely detail about the contact itself. I and my brothers are aware of your thinking, he says. We are aware of your thinking because it is also our thinking, for our minds are as one. But we are not aware of everything in your mind, because at times your thoughts are cut off from us by the individualization that is so common with your peoples. The static is yours. The signal is shared.

A leaf. That is the whole assignment. Not a mountain. Not the ocean. One leaf, studied with care, until your old impressions fall away and you actually see it. I think he chose the leaf on purpose. It is the smallest thing you would normally walk past. Attention is the first spiritual discipline, and the leaf is its first classroom.

Then Oxal speaks, on the other half of the evening's subject. Service. What does it mean to call ourselves the Confederation in the service of our infinite Creator? It is necessary, he says, to serve if you understand, for this is the only route open to us. But service has qualifications, and each of them is obtained through meditation.

Many of the people of your planet attempt to serve, in many ways, but they are not effective. They have not availed themselves to the Creator through meditation. Service must be performed with care. However, it must always be performed. And it is not wise to act beyond your limitations. You will know your ability to serve by availing yourself to this knowledge through meditation.

So the evening gives you two practices, and they are really one. Sit still, clear the mind, stay awake. Then go outside and study a leaf until you see it for the first time. That is how contact begins. That is how service begins. With attention, paid in full, to one small green thing.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Simplicity of Truth
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the simplicity of truth.

January fifteenth, nineteen seventy-four. Hatonn begins with an apology of a different kind. You may wonder, he says, why we give you material that seems elementary, or repeated. We do this because this is what is needed. In actuality, this is all that is needed.

My friends, truth is very, very simple. The Creator's plan is very, very simple. It is not necessary that we weave a complex web of circumstance to lead you to the Creator. He is within you, and you are Him. It is only necessary that you realize this in its fullest sense for you to be aware of all the Creator's wisdom.

The people of this planet, he says, have blocked their minds from this knowledge. And the blockage has a particular shape. They are more accustomed to complexity. They desire intellectual juggling of various propositions and theories. This, my friends, is not necessary. To get from where you are to where you should be requires an understanding that has nothing to do with the intellect. It requires, simply, a knowing of truth.

Consider very carefully these simple teachings, he says, for these simple teachings are all that is required. There is nothing of a complex nature that is needed. I keep hearing the patience in that. How many times can you say the same simple thing, to people who keep asking for something harder?

A questioner asks about personal business decisions. Hatonn answers graciously, and draws a line. We welcome all questions, he says. But we cannot interfere in your plans. Questions about the nature of truth, gladly. Questions about what you should do with your money, no. Each time we act to change your attitudes, it is an infringement, and we must balance it against the good created. So we accelerate only as you desire it.

Then Latui speaks, and he opens with one of my favorite lines in the archive. My friends, I am what you call a space man. But so are you. For where do you dwell but in space? From our point of view, you are as much in space as are we. The only difference is that you are limited in your ability to travel to different points in space.

You are also a space man. There is very little difference between yourselves and us. Our system of transportation is simply a little more refined. We are not separated by distances, he says. We are separated by thinking. You have learned to think in a way that isolates you. It is not necessary that you remain in isolation.

Learn, he says, to totally rebuke arriving at conclusions in what you consider a logical manner, for these conclusions will be based on suppositions made with very weak fabric, the fabric of the creation of man of Earth. If you wish an answer to any question, it is only necessary to base your knowledge on truth. This you can do through meditation. It is always available. It is not necessary to make a complex analysis. There is a correct solution for every problem.

And then he gives the whole of metaphysics in two sentences. The cause, my friends, is the Creator. The effect is love. This is all that there is. This is the simplicity of the truth. Hear my words and understand them.

It has been stated, he says, know the truth, and the truth shall make you free. Free from what? Free from many things, my friends. Free from many, many things. For cutting yourselves off from truth begins to put more and more limitations upon you.

So here it is, the whole evening in one breath. You are a space man who forgot he was in space. The truth is simple enough to say in two sentences. And freedom is not something you earn. It is something you remember.

Thank you for listening.

title: Pure Language
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: pure language.

January sixteenth, nineteen seventy-four. The shortest session so far, and one of the densest. Hatonn speaks for only a few minutes. But every sentence is load-bearing.

This instrument receives my thoughts, he says, and relays them to you. These thoughts are not my exclusive property. They are the thoughts of an entire creation of our infinite Creator. It is not necessary for the instrument to be used for you to know these thoughts. They are available to all people in all places at all times, for they are the thoughts of the Creator. And these thoughts were meant for all of mankind, in all places.

Then he names what the whole archive is circling. These thoughts are very simple. They are a simplicity that is unique, for they are the very foundation of the creation. This is what we are attempting to give man on Earth. This original Thought. This is what he needs at this time.

This Thought can only be approached using pure language, he says. It is not a common concept among the people of your planet. This is the reason for their difficulties. The Creator never imagined difficulties in His creation. They are the product of man's erroneous thinking.

I keep stopping on that phrase. Pure language. Not fancy language. Not precise language. Pure. As if words had a state of cleanliness, and most of ours arrive smudged. The original Thought cannot be reached through smudged words. It has to be approached directly, the way you would approach a fire, without commentary.

We have said to you many times that meditation is necessary, he says. Through this process of meditation, it is possible to know this Thought. We have called it love, but this can only be understood through meditation.

And then the comparison that quietly devastates. In an environment such as yours, he says, meditation is of even greater importance than in an environment such as ours, for we have very, very little to overcome in our understanding of our fellow man. They live close to the Thought. We live far from it, tangled in our own noise. So the practice matters more for us, not less.

One thought, at the foundation of everything. Available to everyone, everywhere, always. Called love, but only truly known in silence. That is the whole of it. That is the whole of everything.

Thank you for listening.

title: An Attack of Love
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: an attack of love.

January seventeenth, nineteen seventy-four. Hatonn opens with a phrase that sounds like a contradiction and turns out to be a strategy. We of the Confederation, he says, are preparing to launch a new attack upon your planet. An attack of love.

If one is to attack with love, he says, it is necessary that it be done with utmost care. The only possibility is that the ones attacked desire that they be attacked. More and more of the people of your planet have become aware of this attack. More and more of them are now welcoming it. For this reason, it is possible to accelerate our program.

Many are aware of some form of attack and are not welcoming it. This results in our limitations. It is necessary that we do not in any way infringe upon those who do not desire the attack. Therefore, we must remain a mystery. A mystery that can be rejected by those who wish to reject our presence.

I love the honesty of that. The most powerful force in the creation, and it waits at the door like a guest. It will not enter uninvited. It makes itself strange enough to be dismissed, so that no one is forced.

Then the larger picture. The speed and the degree of our activities must be regulated, not by us, but by you. The acceptance of us by the total population of this planet is the only governing principle that controls our activities. We will, very shortly, increase these activities. More and more of our craft will be seen. This can be done because they are beginning to accept us. We will do this in order that their curiosity will be stimulated. And this curiosity will lead them to seeking the truth of our presence.

He knows they repeat themselves. We are aware that many of you believe that we repeat ourselves too much. But we have actually only one thing to present to your people. This is truth, and it is very simple. If they would simply learn to accept this truth and utilize it, they would be free of their limitations.

Then he changes the subject, briefly, to something the group has wondered about. How does this contact actually work? How do thoughts move from his mind to the instrument's voice? And he gives the clearest explanation in the early archive.

Sometimes, he says, we impress a concept upon the instrument, and he finds his own words for it. At other times we use muscular control, to aid him in forming words to fit the concepts. If the concept is totally new to his thinking, we use a great deal of control. If it is familiar, we allow him great leeway.

You can experiment yourself, he says. Say a word to yourself without speaking. You will hear it in your mind. One part of your mind has said the word, and another part has heard it, although you have made no sound. It is possible for two, or more, or all minds to work in this manner. It is possible to direct the same word to another mind. It is possible to impress an intellectual concept upon another mind. It is also possible to impress a non-intellectual concept upon another mind.

These are just a few of the simple principles of communication, mind to mind. And then the reminder that steadies the whole strange evening. There is only one source. It is the Creator.

Before he leaves, he drops two details for the skywatchers. There are seven planets in your solar system, he says, that are now inhabited by our craft and our people. Many of these you would not see if you went there. But some you would. And then the appointment. We will be in your skies on the first day of the coming month. You will be aware of our presence at that time.

An attack of love, conducted with utmost care, at the speed of your willingness. And underneath it, one mind, quietly learning to speak to itself.

Thank you for listening.

title: Articulated Light
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: articulated light.

January twenty-first, nineteen seventy-four. The first of two sessions that evening, and the channel is a new one. Carla. Hatonn speaks through her, and the teaching that comes through is among the most precise statements of cosmology in the early archive. It begins with a question.

My friends, of what substance is the universe made? We have told you that this substance is light. You may also call this substance energy, vibration, or consciousness. And yet, my friends, by itself, this substance would remain in an uncorporate state. The shaping force, my friends, is love.

Light is the clay. Love is the hand. And what is shaped from them is you. You, my friends, in your spiritual reality are articulated light shaped by love in such a way that you possess freedom and desire. Your light is shaped by the love of freedom and the love of desire.

I want to sit with that image for a moment. Articulated light. Not a blob, not a vapor. Articulated, jointed, formed with intention, the way a hand has fingers. You are light that has been given shape, and the shape was given by love, and the purpose of the shape is freedom. You are free because you were made to be free. The freedom is not an accident of the design. It is the design.

Before we even consider reincarnation, he says, understand this. You are not in multiple, or a put together device. You are one being, part and parcel of the great universe which is the Creation. And your basic desire is shaped towards reunion with your Creator.

He touches on reincarnation only lightly. Universes are environments for beings to experience and enjoy. Reincarnation is not inevitable. It occurs if further experience within the physical is desired, or if a being desires to be of service within the physical manifestation. It is a choice, not a sentence.

Whatever you call the energies involved in that process, he says, each is a manifestation of love, shaping light in such a way that the soul may have the experiences which it desires.

He even nods to the theologians in the room. The most familiar explanation to this instrument, he says, is the division of the deity into the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. In that picture, the Holy Spirit would serve as the aid where the physical and the spiritual meet, so that soul and body could join. But whatever names the analysts choose, he says, it is all love, shaping light, so the soul may have what it desires.

Then he turns to a word that causes more trouble than almost any other. Morality. We will simply say this, he says, and you may take it for what it is worth. It is difficult to understand intellectually. My friends, there is no morality. There is only love.

If you will radiate love for all, you will never need to know what is right and what is wrong. The entire difficulty with morality is due to a desire to follow rules rather than a desire to follow the Father. Meditation, correctly pursued, quickly shows the basic simplicity of the way of the Father.

That which you term moral decision is within each, and available to all. No matter what the conscious frame of mind, and no matter how many chances have been missed, that which is redeeming lies always within, and not one bit has been taken away from anyone.

And then the sentence I would carry out of this evening like a lamp. Each of us is perfect. Manifestations often do not indicate our knowledge of our perfection. But this, my friends, may be corrected from within.

You are articulated light, shaped by love, already perfect, already free. Everything else is just the long walk home.

Thank you for listening.

title: Reflected a Thousandfold
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: reflected a thousandfold.

January twenty-first, nineteen seventy-four. The second session of the evening. Hatonn returns, and this time his subject is desire. Not desire as craving. Desire as the steering mechanism of the entire creation.

This is the key, my friends. Desire. If the individual does not desire what we have to bring to him, then he will not receive it. This is exactly how the creation is designed. So that each entity, no matter where he is or who he is or what he is, will get exactly what he desires.

Each individual must make up his mind, and he must do it now. He must decide whether he is going to attempt to understand and to serve in the light of the infinite, or whether he is going to seek for himself, and follow a pathway laid down by man on Earth rather than that provided by the Creator of us all.

Man on Earth considers that he has many problems. But these problems are not reality. They are an illusion, developed by his thinking. Nothing in this universe follows the laws man considers the laws of the generation of events. I have stated before that the only cause is the Creator.

Man interprets cause and effect in a very illusory manner. This is not the way the Creation works. It is only necessary that an individual give forth love and light. If this is done, this is what will be returned to him. It is not necessary to consider complex propositions and plans in order to reach an objective assumed to be of great benefit. It is only necessary that you generate the love that is amply provided by the Creator of us all.

Listen to how he describes the alternative, because he has watched us do it for a long time. Man believed that he could generate, through plans and activities, great pleasure that would come to him as a result. And then he goes forth and does these things in great complexity. And very seldom does he glory in their product. But he does not learn, for he does not meditate.

For within him is the truth, the truth of the pathway to the ecstasy that awaits him. It is not a complex pathway. It is not a product of his intellect, or of his ability to act in the physical, producing great changes in the many things he desired for his pleasure.

The pathway, my friends, is simply love. A total and universal love, expressed for all things and all peoples, and demonstrated daily in his activities and thoughts. And then, my friends, everything is returned. And this love that he generates is reflected on him a thousandfold.

For this is the plan. This is the design. This is the gift of the Father. It is so very simple, for the Father is very simple. He did not mean for His children to find it necessary to generate complexities in order to achieve the state of ecstasy that He designed for them.

It is only man on this planet that has become confused, and drifted away from this knowledge. This knowledge is deep within you. It is part of you. It is part of everything that exists. Seek this knowledge within yourself. And then go forth in your daily activities demonstrating to your fellow man this knowledge, and it will be reflected a thousandfold.

He warns about one more trap. Each individual will interpret information given to him in a slightly different way, if it is of an intellectual nature. Some will not be able to interpret it at all. This is why it is so necessary that man of Earth meditate and go within. For what he obtains in this fashion will not be of an intellectual nature. It will be the truth itself. And there will be no question in his mind, and no need for interpretation.

Give forth love and light. That is the whole machine. What you send out comes back multiplied by a thousand. The only question, as always, is what you desire.

Thank you for listening.

title: Nothing But Thought
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: nothing but thought.

January twenty-third, nineteen seventy-four. Hatonn speaks about the message, the receivers, and the strange fact that some people are receiving the Confederation's communications without having any idea who is sending them.

Upon your planet at present there are people in almost all areas that are receiving our communications, he says. Many of them do not understand what is happening to them. They have no concept of people coming to them from the stars. This is unimportant. The only thing that is important is that they understand the message. The message of love and brotherhood.

We are here for one thing, he says. To bring this simple, single message. This is what is necessary for the people of your planet to learn at this time. And then he states the metaphysics underneath it, in one of the starkest sentences in the archive.

There is nothing but thought. It is found in many forms and expressions, but thought is the source of all that there is. The thought of the Creator. And this is what you are. And you are able, like the Creator, to generate thought. The thought that you generate is your responsibility.

The people of this planet each generate thought, and communicate these thoughts to others. If the thoughts generated are of a low quality, then they will in turn generate low-quality thoughts in others. This is a self-perpetuating action. And this is the reason for the strife and confusion so abundant with the people of this planet.

It is erroneous to say you cannot do anything about a situation created by millions and millions of minds over thousands and thousands of years. It is only necessary that the individual remove himself in thought from this sea of confusion, and express himself in the true love and light of the infinite Creator. This may be done at any time. It is up to the individual. If he desires to do this, then it is only necessary that he do it.

This has been demonstrated many times by the teachers who came to show the people of Earth life as it was intended. It is a very simple lesson, but man on Earth desires to ignore it. Very few accept these teachings and stand in the light and express only the love and understanding of the Creator of us all.

He admits to being puzzled. We have been puzzled at times by the inability of the people of this planet to be awakened to this simple truth. People hear the words. They understand them. They agree totally with the concepts. And still they cannot assimilate them into their own thinking. The barrier is solid. It was built over thousands of years.

The way through the barrier is not more words. It is meditation, which bypasses the intellectual barrier and reaches the spiritual self directly. And it is constant awareness. He suggests that if progress seems slow, additional meditation may be necessary. For only in this way can the people of Earth free themselves from the erroneous thoughts impressed upon them for so very long.

Why is it necessary, he asks, for people who have been made aware of truth through their seeking to stop short of achieving the knowledge of their true created purpose? We suggest that it is necessary to maintain a continual awareness of your objective. That objective is to realize your true position in the creation, and then to act in the manner intended by the Creator. The state of hypnosis is so great, he says, that to free himself from it, the individual must maintain a constant awareness of his spiritual nature and purpose, and augment it with meditation.

This step must be successfully made by each individual of this planet at some time or other. Wouldn't it be reasonable, he asks, to do it at the earliest possible time? For it is an extremely beneficial step. And if progress seems slow, then additional meditation may be necessary. The effort will be more rewarding than any other activity the individual can engage in.

He closes with a line from the last great teacher, offered as proof of what we are. Know ye not that ye are Gods? This man understood the true created purpose of all of mankind.

It is all around you, Hatonn says, at the very end. It is you, as it is I. Open your minds and your hearts, and let it fill you with its love. Nothing but thought. And the thought, at the bottom of everything, is love.

Thank you for listening.

title: Never Uninvited
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: never uninvited.

January twenty-fifth, nineteen seventy-four. The second session of the day, and an unusual one. No single voice claims it. The notes say these are fragments, received from unknown, preserved from an early collection. But the teaching is whole, and it is about distance. Why the Confederation stays far away, and what would have to change for that to end.

We would prefer to land upon your surface and greet you openly, they say. But we are aware of certain principles in this creation that do not allow for such a direct infringement.

Due to the situation now evolving on your planet, the transition from one vibration to another, it is necessary that we come to you at this time. It is also necessary that you avail yourself to us. For there will be many, many things given to the ones who will accept the Creator's plan and way.

Then the cosmology, stated plainly. There are vast distances between stars, between planetary systems, between individual planets. These distances are made to be navigated by peoples of the creation who have gained the ability to navigate them. If people have reached this state of evolution, they can cross the distances between planets, between systems, even between galaxies. If they have not, they are limited to their own planet.

And here is the sentence I want to keep. We do not in any instance enter a house uninvited. It may seem a strange way of thinking to those of your planet, but it is the plan of the Creator. It was planned that only those of sufficient spiritual evolution should travel from system to system. However, vast numbers of people in this creation are so evolved, and have this ability.

Some of the people of planet Earth have this ability too, they say, and do it in a spiritual form, leaving their physical bodies behind. Each of you has this ability. All that is necessary is that you realize it by demonstrating in your daily life a complete understanding of the principles we give you. The principles of love and total brotherhood for all who exist throughout the creation.

It is unfortunate that it is necessary to limit a group of people to a planet, they admit. But it is the wisdom of the Creator that has done this. And there is mercy in the design. The people so limited are not aware of their limitations, and therefore do not reach a state of mental frustration from the knowledge of them. He does not wish anything bad for any of His children.

When His children reach a state of understanding, and may then move from one planet or system to another of their own abilities, He welcomes them with open arms.

So the distance is not punishment. It is quarantine with the door left open. No one enters your house uninvited, including the ones who could. And the invitation is not a word you say. It is a life you live.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Stream of Consciousness
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the stream of consciousness.

January twenty-sixth, nineteen seventy-four. Laitos opens the evening, working with a new instrument, a channel known as R. There is difficulty. The contact keeps breaking. He apologizes, and keeps returning. Your daily meditation is necessary, he tells them, in order that the veil might be lifted, and all things which you have been promised will be shown.

Then Hatonn takes the instrument, and gives the evening its subject. The future. But first, he says, we need to agree on what that word means. You see the future as something that will come to you. We see the future as an event that is presently here.

Time, my friends, is an illusion. The creation is, in fact, timeless. You are at a particular point in the evolution of the creation. There seems to be a progression of time. But there is actually a continuing stream of consciousness. It is only necessary to displace yourself along this stream of consciousness to be at any point along the stream that you call time.

In other words, it is possible to move through time as you understand movement through space. Each of these concepts is as real as the other. We have stated to you previously that there is one place and there is one time. This place and this time are the creation. We are able to move through space. We are also able to move through time, for in actuality these things are the same thing. They are the creation.

The limitations you feel, he says, are not ordinary. They are impressed upon those who desire them, for certain experiences. Each individual in this creation is able to select precisely what he desires. This is exactly the plan of the Creator. He not only gave man free will, but He gave man the ability to select exactly what he desired.

Some who explored, explored in a direction that led them away from the all-knowing One, the all-loving One.
