And as it receives and gives love, it obeys the law of service. There is no personality necessary in order to express the Creator's love.

Man has been given free will, and therefore man is also a creator. And man creates many things within the illusion. These things separate him from other entities and from the true creation. One of the most effective of these separating devices, he says, is the building up of personality. To be involved in personality is to be involved in the illusion.

So how do you serve anyone, if everyone is wearing this costume? The ability to withdraw from consideration of personality, he says, will let you seek much more efficiently within the realm of service. For it is not nearly as effective to serve an entity while responding to personality as it is to serve an entity while conscious of that entity only as a perfect child of a perfect Father. All is one, my friends. There is no personality necessary, for all is in unity and all is in love.

That sentence is worth sitting with. Serve the person, not the personality.

The second half of the session turns to the new vibration, the rising hum these early transcripts keep circling. The increased vibration is affecting the consciousness of all of you, he says. And as it increases, the negative conditions within your consciousness begin to stir, for they are being repelled by the higher vibration. That which is of a negative nature within you must be decided upon by each entity. Each must choose how to rid himself of this negative.

This is beginning to occur, he says, and it shall rapidly grow. Do not be alarmed by what rises. It is being lifted so it can be released.

And then the most startling passage of the evening. As we look down upon your planet, he says, we can see it in all its beauty. The planet known as Earth has an extremely beautiful appearance. It seems perfect, and indeed, it is perfect. It is the desires of those who seek to look with their intellects far too closely that produce the many concepts of imperfection with which your planet abounds.

Read that again in your head. It is perfect. The imperfections are a product of looking too closely with the intellect. The world is not broken. The lens is.

The session ends on a note of plain encouragement. It is simply a matter of constant effort in availing yourself to the contact. It will become more and more easy to receive our thoughts.

You are dreaming, but the dream is beautiful. And somewhere underneath it, you already know.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Villain Within
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the villain within.

This is one of the shortest sessions in the archive, and one of the sharpest. Hatonn opens with an observation. There has been a slight intensification of difficulty among those who are seeking within the group. Lately things have gotten harder, not easier. And the reason, he says, is very simple.

Once you have been alerted to the true pathway of spiritual seeking, once you know that your physical existence is the environment you chose in order to learn, you will begin to experience a certain cycle of testing. As you learn more about the spiritual path, you will find a way to either demonstrate that knowledge, or to refrain from demonstrating it.

This is the price of being told the truth. Knowing it means you are now expected to live it. Each of those who is honestly seeking is now at a stage where he has learned enough to be tested, and to be consciously aware that he is being tested by his higher self.

And then Hatonn says something that should be carved over every doorway. It is in actuality an occasion to rejoice, he says. For each demonstration of the way of the Father raises your vibration that much closer to your original perfect vibration.

Difficulty is not a sign you have failed. It is a sign you have been promoted.

Then comes the turn that gives this episode its title. We have found, he says, that in each entity who seeks within the physical illusion for wisdom, there is one great villain who steals all of the truth, all of the progress, and all of the awareness that he can from each of us. Who is this villain, my friends?

You may look and look for this villain, but I must tell you, you may not go very far before you find him. For this villain is yourself.

There is a type of specific illusion which is termed personality. It has to do with the physical illusion. It is given by the Father the power of creation. And this so-called personality creates many, many ideas and concepts and false realities which very effectively baffle the attempt of the spirit to maintain contact with the One who is all.

Listen to how they put it. Not a demon from outside. Not bad luck. Not other people. The self you built to survive the illusion is the thing stealing your progress. It creates false realities, and it does it with the power of creation itself.

It is not a difficult thing, he says, to recognize the workings of this illusory self. It is somewhat difficult to inhibit its actions. The constant attempt to remain in a meditative state will be of great help in meeting these tests. It is only necessary to continue to seek.

It may seem difficult, he says. And indeed, it is difficult. And yet, my friends, it is difficult no matter what road you choose. The rewards of the spiritual seeking, however, are somewhat more worth the difficulty.

I love the honesty of that. He does not promise that the spiritual road is easy. He promises only that the other roads are hard too, and pay less.

He closes with one of those sentences that sounds like a koan and turns out to be a key. We are His and you are His. We are all one. We are one mind and one being. Do not let yourself separate you from yourself.

There is much to rejoice in, he says. And we rejoice in being able to attempt to serve you.

The villain is you. Which means the hero is also you. That is the whole test.

Thank you for listening.

title: We Are You
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: we are you.

This session begins as a personal message, and it answers a question that must have been troubling one of the instruments. When the thoughts come through, whose thoughts are they? Mine, or yours?

Hatonn's answer is one of the great passages of the early archive. If you consider the source of your thoughts to be within yourself, he says, then you are correct. However, you are also correct if you consider the source of these messages to be the Confederation of Planets. We are real, as real as yourselves. In some instances there are thoughts given to you from us. However, these thoughts are then your thoughts, for they were given to you to keep. And they were given to you by yourself. For we are you and you are we.

There is only one consciousness. There is no separation.

Read that slowly. There is only one consciousness. Everything else, including the very idea of a sender and a receiver, is an arrangement for convenience.

So which thought is valid, the one the instrument generates or the one the Confederation generates? All thoughts, my friends, are valid. There is no such thing as a thought that is not a valid thought. The only question is whether the thought you are aware of is one you would wish to use for your own edification.

I keep turning that over. Every thought is valid. The work is not in sorting true from false. The work is in choosing which truths you will feed.

Because these thoughts carry more than their apparent meanings. Each individual who becomes aware of them becomes aware of a meaning for himself. Each uses each thought in his own particular way. And yet each of these individuals, and each of these individual thoughts, are part of the same thing.

And so we have conditions of an infinite entity communicating through its parts to its parts, and evolving through this process. And yet its parts, in many instances, do not become consciously aware of their unity with each of the other parts, and therefore consciously create the separation which is erroneous.

That is the whole human condition in one sentence. One mind, talking to itself through billions of mouths, and most of the mouths convinced they are alone.

We of the Confederation are here, he says, for we know we are here. For we, like you, cannot be anyplace else. For here is the creation. The creation is totally unified. And here, my friends, here is all places and in all times.

It is only necessary to become aware of your real nature, of your identification, for you to merge with reality. It is not what you conceive it to be. It is all places and one place. It is all things and one thing. It is all times and one time.

There is no separation. There is a single consciousness. All separations are illusory. If we speak of being from elsewhere, he says, we speak to you using terms appropriate to your illusion. There is no possibility of separating our thoughts from your thoughts except in the illusory manner practiced by many of those who dwell upon this particular planet.

So the next time a good thought arrives uninvited, do not interrogate its passport. It was given to you to keep. And it was given to you by yourself.

Thank you for listening.

title: A Completely New Life
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: a completely new life.

The session is interrupted by a telephone call, right in the middle of a sentence. Hatonn does not mind. He simply continues where he left off, talking about meditation, and he says the thing that makes this evening worth keeping.

Meditation, my friends, is a much more basic and much more general technique than you may think. It is not part of a daily life. It is the beginning of a completely new life. It is a replacement.

Not a habit. Not a hobby. A replacement. The two types of life, that not in meditation and that in meditation, are two completely different vibrations. The normal physical existence dwells completely within the illusion. Meditation is an attempt to contact your original identity, the consciousness of the all. This consciousness is a much different reality. A transcendent reality to that of the illusion.

We might even call it the reality, he says, were it not for the fact that we know there are transcendent states to any reality, until we are truly aware of unity with all that there is. This is a higher state than we have yet achieved. And we, too, are seeking towards it.

I love that honesty. The teachers admit they are still climbing. The ladder has no top they have found.

To dwell in the higher reality is an experience transcendent to your illusion. It sheds its own light upon your life as you return to the illusion. And it is necessary, he says, when dealing with the illusion, to refrain from attempting to discern your own desires within the illusion. Take your questions into meditation. There is a purpose to your life which is not to be discerned within the illusion, but only while you are in contact with your true reality within the all.

Turn towards your true consciousness in meditation. When there are pressures, doubts and difficulties, turn to meditation. When there continue to be these, continue to turn to meditation. There will come, in time, a simple awareness of what is required, and at that time, the ability and the tools with which to do it.

The Creator, and that part of the Creator which is you in your true form, have provided you with each day. And each need is taken care of along the path you are intending to go. Trust to this.

Then the contact passes to another instrument, stumbles, pauses, apologizes for delays. And through the static comes the second jewel of the evening. The key to a knowledge of the path ahead, he says, is a knowledge of yourself.

It has been said in your holy works that not all those who are called are chosen. Hatonn says the instrument's mind supplied that phrase, but it is not understood correctly. In truth, he says, each of those called is chosen. The call that is felt is a true one.

But then comes the work. You must know yourself. And then you will see that the choice is to seek, and you have already done this. After that choice, it is always clear, very soon, that your way is a way of service. And then your choice becomes cloudy again. For it is very difficult to know what your service is.

And yet, do not fear. For you will be of service if you so desire. You have been called. It is up to you to choose, each step, how you will be of service. Each of you has his own talents and his own way. These ways are many. As many as there are people.

The tape ends mid-sentence. But the evening is complete. Meditation is not something you add to your life. It is the life you were meant to replace this one with.

Thank you for listening.

title: By Their Fruits
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: by their fruits.

The group has been asking a practical question. Once you have found something in meditation, how do you share it? How do you carry the knowledge outward without breaking it?

Hatonn's answer is blunt. That which you intellectually know may be useful to you. But there can quickly be misunderstanding through overuse of the logical and the intellectual. So when you are asked a spiritual question, do not reach for your store of gained knowledge first. Simply relax. Seek to know the light and the love of the Father. And that which you may best do to serve the Creator will be easy for you to do.

Then the contact moves to another instrument, and the evening's real teaching begins. It is about the teacher known as Jesus. And it reframes his whole ministry in two sentences.

The man that you knew as Jesus was able to communicate very much with the people of this planet. He did almost none of this in an intellectual manner.

Almost none. The greatest teacher your planet remembers did not teach by argument. He taught another way entirely. By their fruits, ye shall know them, it has been written in your holy works. This, Hatonn says, is the essence of what we attempt to bring to you. An ability to do the works that you shall be known by.

These works will be simply a demonstration of your understanding of truth. This truth is quite simple. It is the truth that permeates all things. It is an understanding of the principle of creation and of the Creator: the principle of universal love.

If you are able to demonstrate this in every thought that you express or experience, regardless of the circumstances, then you will be the example set by the teacher known to you as Jesus.

Regardless of the circumstances. Not when it is easy. Not when the room agrees with you. In every thought. That is the standard, and it is absolute.

There have been many teachers upon your planet who expressed this understanding of love. However, very, very few of those who experienced this expression understood it. This is of no great consequence, he says. It is important only that the individual learn to understand it himself.

And the only way we know of learning this is through daily meditation. Meditation which will bring you the active seeking and demonstration of this understanding of love. This is all that is necessary for any individual in the infinite creation. This is all that is necessary for you to convey to your fellow man.

And here is the sentence that answers the group's question. The only way that you can convey this is through demonstration.

Not through explanation. Not through persuasion. Not through the careful arrangement of true statements. You cannot talk anyone into love. You can only show them what it looks like, living in a human being, under pressure, in real circumstances. That is the whole method. That was always the method.

The session breaks down after that. An instrument loses the contact. Long pauses. The rest is inaudible. But nothing more needed to be said.

If you want to share what you found in the silence, do not describe the silence. Become the kind of person the silence produces. They will know you by your fruits.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Simple Remedy
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the simple remedy.

Tonight is the practical one. If you have ever wondered exactly how these voices say meditation should be done, this is the session. Hatonn speaks through a new instrument, and he lays it out like an instruction card.

There are many ways to meditate, he says. There is, however, only one true form of meditation. It is necessary, if meditation is to be effective, that the intellectual mind be allowed to cease functioning. For this acts as a type of interference to the realizing and understanding that is within all beings.

The thinking mind is not the enemy. It is the static. You have to turn down the static to hear the station.

The steps are simple. Be in an atmosphere free from outside distractions. This is of great aid at the beginning. Maintain a posture in which the spine is approximately vertical. The body should be comfortable, but not so relaxed that the spine is not vertical. This, he says, is perhaps the most important aspect. Once the position is assumed, allow the mind to slowly discontinue its thoughts. Focus upon one object, or upon the center of the forehead, or simply allow intellectual thoughts to leave the mind.

As this continues, there will be a slow cessation of the awareness of the physical body. Maintain this state for a reasonable period of time. The length depends on your desire. The benefits will become obvious, and therefore your length of meditation will depend completely upon your own desires.

There are many benefits from this process. It is up to the individual to discover them for himself, for they are beyond communication in terms of your language.

I like that. The real benefits cannot be described. Which is itself a kind of instruction. Stop reading about it and sit down.

Then the message widens, and it widens into something fierce. We of the Confederation are bringing to the people of Earth a simple message and simple instructions. Since these are the only things needed at this time. There is but one lesson to be learned. It is the lesson of awareness.

We find the people of this planet are blind, for they cannot see. We find they are crippled, since they cannot move. We find they are dumb, because they do not understand. And each of these maladies is a result of one disease. A disease very easily remedied.

A remedy which we bring and offer. A simple remedy which can be practiced and administered to all. A simple remedy of meditation. To open the eyes. To free the spirit. To clear the mind. So that man of Earth may regain his normal abilities.

Blind, crippled, dumb. One disease. One remedy. The diagnosis is brutal and the prescription is almost insultingly simple. Sit still. Spine straight. Mind quiet. Daily.

He closes the way these early sessions always close, with a promise that sounds too large until you test it. Return to the knowledge that is yours as provided by your Creator. It is available at any time. It is available at any place. It is only necessary that you reach out and accept it.

Not earned. Not bought. Not studied into existence. Available. At any time, in any place. The only move is yours.

Thank you for listening.

title: Seek and Find
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: seek and find.

The subject this evening is seeking itself. The group has heard many times that they should seek, and Hatonn feels it is not fully understood. So he starts at the beginning, with the promise written in their holy works. It is necessary to seek in order to find.

The method he recommends is the one he always recommends. Meditation. He does not disapprove of reading, of studying manuscripts and materials. This is of a beneficial nature. But there is no way, to his knowledge, to arrive at the goals that one who is truly seeking desires, unless he spends considerable time in meditation.

Meditation is a strange phenomenon, he says. It does not at first seem that the individual is making progress. But this is not correct. Progress is always made when an individual meditates. If he can clear his conscious mind of thoughts, and relax while maintaining the spine in a vertical position, he opens his mind to much more than his normal awareness allows.

Then comes one of the great definitions in the archive. Truth, my friends, being simply defined as that which is the same regardless of who is aware of it. Truth is the same for you as it is for us. It is the same for the Creator as it is for you or us. Truth is an absolute.

The understanding of this absolute is variable. Some have a vague or shaded understanding. Others have a much clearer one. But the truth itself does not change with the viewer. It waits the same for everyone.

And why do people differ so much in their understanding of it? The differences are due primarily, and almost exclusively, to one thing. Their meditations. Whether these meditations occurred in this incarnation, or in a previous one and were carried over.

Think about what that means. The clarity you have is not an accident of talent. It is an accumulation of practice, some of it older than your name.

The Creator intended for his children to experience what they desired in every instance. He assumed they would act intelligently and choose desires that lead to enjoyment of the creation. But man on Earth, Hatonn says, has suffered many aberrations from his lack of understanding. When an individual is experiencing something he does not wish to experience, he is experiencing it due to his ignorance. And this ignorance is a product of his lack of communication with the original thought. And this lack of communication is simply due to a lack of meditation.

Man on Earth has generated an illusion of false values so strong that he finds it almost impossible to return to the simplicity of the original thought that generated it. And that thought, he says, can be expressed with one word in your language. That word, my friends, is of course love.

It is unnecessary to complicate your thinking in any way other than to express the simple love of your Creator. If this is done, and the understanding is augmented through daily meditation, the illusory system of values built up by years of erroneous thinking will become meaningless. And the only true meaning remaining in your consciousness will be the simple acceptance of the love of your Creator.

So he makes the ask plain. Join with your brothers of the Confederation in rejecting all concepts other than the concept given by the Creator. Remove from your thinking everything but this love. Do this through daily meditation. And then you will know the joy that we in his service know.

For this, my friends, is the creation. The joy of knowing and expressing the love of our Creator.

Seek, and you shall find. The finding was never the hard part. The seeking is.

Thank you for listening.

title: Like a Little Child
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: like a little child.

This session opens with a startling claim, delivered almost casually. Hatonn says he is speaking from a craft, above the house the group is sitting in. Our craft, he says, would be visible to this group upon request.

He does not linger on it. The craft is not the point. The point is the question the group keeps asking, the one he answers through another instrument. Why don't those brothers from space meet us face to face? Why don't they bring a craft down where we can get a close look?

The answer is gentle and a little embarrassing. One of the problems in contacting your peoples, he says, is what I should call an overreaction. Either based upon fear, or a semblance of what you might even call worship. Neither one of those attitudes is necessary, or even desirable.

Realize, he says, that when you have reached a maturity in your development that will allow you to meet us casually, as an equal, I should say, as a friend, when all of you can greet us in this way, then our meeting, face to face contact, will be more possible.

Not as monsters. Not as gods. As friends. Until we can manage that, the distance stays.

Most of the evening, though, is not about the craft. It is about the instruments themselves, the new channels fumbling to receive. Hatonn is patient with them in a way that becomes the whole teaching. Do not be afraid of making errors, he says. I will correct any error that might be made. Simply avail yourself to the contact.

And then he tells a story. This is the part I want you to hear. He tells it to focus their thinking on what is necessary to receive his thoughts. It is about a small child.

This small child listens to its parents, and its parents speak to it. The child, before listening to its parents, could not speak. But after listening to its parents, it could speak quite fluently. However, the child was totally unaware of the process by which it learned to speak. It simply was there, and it simply learned to speak.

This is the process we are using, he says. Not to say that you are as a little child. That is the problem. If you were as a little child, we could speak through you with no difficulty. The problem is that you are not as a little child.

We recommend that you think of yourself as you would of a little child, and relax, and know nothing. In this way you will very rapidly learn.

The child has no knowledge of what it is supposed to do. It simply speaks. The adult analyzes, doubts, edits, and strangles the message before it is born. Analysis, he says, is detrimental to this type of communication. The experienced instrument does very little analysis of what is given. In the beginning he analyzed, and it took a great amount of time to transmit a single thought, with very little success.

We have found, he says, that peoples in a technological society such as yours sometimes require great effort, because they have learned to question quite carefully everything that is presented to them. If you do not question what we are attempting to do, but simply relax and let it happen, it will happen.

He closes by saying that all of you in the room are capable of thought transfer. All that is required is that you desire it.

Know nothing. Relax. Let it happen. The child learned to speak without studying the throat. You can learn to listen the same way.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Soul Does Not Sleep
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the soul does not sleep.

This is a question evening, and the questions are the big ones. The group wants to know about the abduction of Betty and Barney Hill, as told in The Interrupted Journey. Were those visitors evil? Are evil planets trying to invade Earth?

Hatonn's answer is careful. The entities of which you have spoken were friendly, he says. They were a scientific expedition which had good intentions, but their knowledge of life forms on this planet was lacking. They had no intention to commit any sort of infringement. They had been cautioned by the Confederation to refrain from investigating in populated areas. They wished only to collect specimens of the fauna, and to gain data about the predominant life forms.

They did not attack then. They will not attack you. Their intentions are positive.

As for other visitors, he is honest about the range of the cosmos. There are many, many myriads of populations. Many are extremely advanced. And a few are not only advanced but of a nature you might call evil. But then the sentence that steadies the whole answer. The Creator is at the end of your path. Your faith is far stronger, if you indeed realize it, than any evil.

And the definition of evil he gives is worth keeping. Be aware, he says, that the only true nature of evil is separation from the Creator. It cannot touch you if you maintain your contact with the One who is all.

Then the line that has echoed down the decades. Do not fear, my friends. There is nothing to fear but fear. This has been said before upon your planet, and it is quite true. Never waste time in fear or in hatred or in anger. For it is only another opportunity, at such a time, to experience and to demonstrate the love and the light of the infinite Creator.

Asked why they cannot meet face to face, he answers with something close to a riddle. I will meet you face to face on the day you enter the kingdom of heaven. You may do this at any time. It is doubtful you will do it while in the body. If you achieve this state, whether in the body or not, you would be able to speak with me on any level you desired. At that point you would recognize me as your brother. No more, my friend, and no less.

Then the question about sex. Is it better to be a monk on the spiritual path? Hatonn refuses both camps. Sexuality is neither good nor evil, he says. Your physical body is neither good nor evil. Sexual activity, as such, is neither good nor evil. The natural activities upon your planet are part of the Creator's plan. It exists simply as an opportunity. It is completely under the control of each individual as to the use he puts this opportunity.

There is only one answer for each person, he says. Some need this experience deeply. Some have little need for it. The crowds lined up on one side or the other are reasoning about an infinite situation. And holiness cannot be imposed. The detachment some masters show is properly attained as a natural result, an involuntary occurrence upon achieving a transcendent state. Not as a rule you force on yourself.

And finally, the question that gives this episode its title. The soul does not sleep. What does it do when the body is asleep?

At night, my friends, you truly come alive. That is his answer. Many upon your planet only rise in consciousness in their sleep. There is a desperate starvation upon your planet, the starvation of spirits that have forgotten how to contact their Creator. During sleep, your spirit involuntarily goes directly into the real universe, and breathes and lives and radiates the joy of the Creator.

This, he says, is the reason for the amount of sleep needed upon this planet. It is necessary in order to give enough food to the spirit. And those who through meditation have found a conscious contact with the Creator may find that less sleep is adequate.

Asked whether we remember any of it on waking, he says: all is remembered, my friends. Nothing is forgotten. There will be much remembering of much that we seem to have forgotten when we leave this chemical vehicle and this heavy illusion.

So tonight, when you lie down, remember. You are not switching off. You are going home for the night.

Thank you for listening.

title: Understanding Is Simple
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: understanding is simple.

Hatonn is direct with this group in a way that stings a little. He has been listening to their spiritual conversation, and he has noticed something. Your minds are stayed far, far too strongly upon those illusory goals of the intellect, he says, which your conscious awareness makes such advanced company of.

These intellectual pretensions, my friends, are no kind of advanced company to be in. Their group name is complexity. And, my friends, understanding is simple.

That is the whole evening in two sentences. Complexity is the name of the club everyone is trying to join. Understanding left the club long ago. It is waiting somewhere quiet.

Let us examine this concept, he says. Understanding is simple. It is unitary. It is not logical. It is not intellectual. It is not necessary that you understand understanding. It is not necessary that anyone around you understand what you are understanding.

It is necessary only for you to seek the understanding of the true creation within. And this we will attempt to give you in a simple way. With the intellect and with words, we can only approximate understanding to you. Your attempts to examine it on an intellectual level can only be a type of subterfuge, camouflage and misdirection.

I love that he does not soften it. Trying to think your way to understanding is not merely slow. It is camouflage. It is the mind dressing up avoidance as effort.

You must not depend upon the tools of the physical illusion in order to build your bridge to eternity. For that which is of the illusion will vanish and be no more before you are able to cross that bridge.

Let go of the preconceptions embedded deep in your intellectual mind. Allow yourself simply to seek, and then to have faith in the seeking. What you seek is simple. The creation is simple.

And then he gives the simple thing. There is only one understanding which we can offer you, my friends, and that is that the creation is one great Being. The creation is you. The creation is me. The creation is all that ever was and ever will be. The creation, my friends, is the Creator.

As you look into the eyes of another upon your planet, you are looking at the Creator. As he looks at you, my friends, he also is looking at the Creator.

If you can achieve this simple understanding, then and only then you may live in harmony with the understanding of the Creator, who created each portion of his creation in order that it may be of service to every other portion of the creation.

This is our understanding, he says. This is our simple understanding. All is one. We cannot speak to you in any complex manner, for we do not have a complex statement.

The session is brief. The contact passes to another instrument and the tape gives out. But the message does not need more room. He is asking you to do one thing. Allow that portion of yourself which is stored with the knowledge of all of the creation to come into life within you. Allow it to do so by exposing it to the love and the light of the Creator through meditation.

Seek, my friends. Seek understanding. And through meditation, understanding will be given.

Not figured out. Given. Like rain.

Thank you for listening.

title: Be Like the Water
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: be like the water.

Hatonn begins with an examination of conscience. Consider the nature of your interior universe, he says. How much of your thinking is involved with striving, attaining, and grasping at things within the physical illusion? What fire consumes you? What greed or envy or base desire have you allowed to continue to have power over your thinking?

And then, what portion of your thinking is clear, calm, motionless, humble, unassuming, and content?

I do not need to tell you, he says, which portion of your interior universe is more correctly called the spiritual part.

The truth of the universe is a very simple truth. Correctly understood and practiced, it eliminates the striving for selfhood within the physical illusion. It eliminates it because it offers a more rewarding reality along the spiritual path.

And if you have not yet become one with the spiritual path, do not cause yourself anxiety. It is not because you have not been trying. It is simply that the illusion under which you labor is extremely strong upon your planet. There is a good deal of constant and faithful meditation and discipline to be achieved before the final breakthrough can come.

Then he gives the image. As you go through your daily existence, he says, contemplate that which is called water.

Water, my friends, is the humblest and weakest of all substances. It abides in the lowest places. It constantly seeks a level. It flows where every opportunity takes it. And yet water may wear away the hardest substances. For it is far stronger in its weakness than rigid substances can ever be.

Be like the water, my friends. Upon the spiritual path that you are seeking to follow, seek the nature of water.

Through another instrument the teaching continues. Seek to become the water, still and pure. It has been said that life is as a vast ocean, and we very often cause waves through our actions and our thoughts. Your thought, my friends, is that which creates tides and waves. See your thoughts as waves. The waves that you create have a vast effect upon the rest of the body of water.

Through self-discipline it is possible to wear away those qualities about yourself that would be considered undesirable. Through lack of control of your actions and thoughts, great storms will arise. By directing your thought, you direct the waves.

Consider then your thoughts like unto the waves, and consider that which directs the water. That director is you, underneath the weather.

And then a third instrument takes it further. Like the spirit, water flows quietly along its path until it reaches an obstacle. It then must go around or over the obstacle. In going around or over an obstacle, it will erode the obstacle. Then the obstacle is no more, and the spirit, like the water, is free of that obstacle.

Water does not argue with the rock. It does not resent the rock. It simply keeps arriving, quiet and persistent, until the rock is gone.

The session ends with a question from the group. Is it harmful or helpful to use drugs, especially for intellectual purposes? Hatonn's answer fits the water teaching perfectly. The use of any outside stimulus has no appreciable effect upon your internal spirit, he says. The difficulty is that these substances are external, and do not come under the will of you, the individual who is seeking.

It may be an acceptable therapeutic measure, to increase one's faith in the reality of the spiritual path, to experience such a state by means of an outside stimulus. But the use of meditation and service, wherein your will makes its own contact with the Creator, is a far more realistic way of entering upon the spiritual path.

The use of outside agents simply puts you in places which you are not ready to comprehend or make use of. True seeking is inner seeking. To be able to give, it is best to refrain from taking. It is far better to achieve an awareness of the creation through meditation than through the use of any external agent.

Be the water. Go low. Stay quiet. Keep arriving. The obstacle is already eroding.

Thank you for listening.

title: Accept Much, Reject Nothing
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: accept much, reject nothing.

Hatonn opens with an observation that must have sounded strange in nineteen seventy-four, and sounds stranger now. It is very interesting to us, he says, to notice the constant and widespread misapprehensions under which your people labor with regard to the idea of normalcy.

There are many things looked upon within your physical illusion as being quite normal, which to us look quite abnormal. As we patiently search among the people of your planet, we find very few whose actions we would call normal. It is as though the people of planet Earth are all mysteriously prey to some widespread emotional disorder.

An abnormality has been developing through many of your generations, he says, until now what is in truth normal has become unheard of, and its place completely overtaken by that which is complete illusion. You have accepted the illusion, and simply reacted to what seems to be reality.

The fault is certainly not your own, within this particular physical experience. However, it has happened. But were there not hope that you might reestablish contact with reality, we would not be here.

And then the sentence that stops me every time. The very few people upon your planet who see reality are often thought to be quite insane.

The sane look mad. The mad look sane. The whole planet has agreed on the wrong definition, and the agreement is what makes it feel true.

So what do you do? One must not attempt to understand what we are giving on the level of language, he says. Go within, my friends, and meditate. For knowledge of reality will come only from within.

Accept nothing on blind faith, but accept everything that is of good report. Allow all paradoxes to remain so. Accept much, and reject nothing.

I keep returning to that instruction. Allow all paradoxes to remain so. Do not force them to resolve. Let two true things sit side by side even when they refuse to shake hands. The resolution comes later, from a higher floor.

Because seeking has a shape, and the shape is not a straight line. There are many ways of gaining what you seek, he says. However, what you seek now will change. It will change as you seek it, for this is the nature of seeking. As you seek, you find. And as you find, you understand. And as you understand, you continue in seeking, but at a different level.

So do not attempt to understand that which at present seems beyond you. Simply go within, and you will be led to an understanding that will place you upon a new plateau, from which you will be able to view much more of reality.

Seeking, my friends, is not a direct attempt to understand each intellectual question which crosses your mind. Seeking is the attempt to know one's Creator. There will be in your seeking an unfoldment of understanding. Each step will show itself to you. When it does, raise yourself upon it, so that you may find the next one.

There will be many paradoxes in your seeking, for this is the nature of seeking. But as you continue, these will dissolve. For you will reach a new plateau, and a new understanding. And the seeming paradox that you bypassed will appear in its true light.

Meditation, he says, is the only method of which we know to allow an individual to rapidly form this new basis for understanding. For it is not dependent upon preconceptions. It is not dependent upon the definitions of a language that was never intended for spiritual seeking.

Redefine that which you experience. Redefine it through your seeking, and through your growing awareness of the creation. And then, my friends, you will not question, for you will know.

You will have grown past the questions, not by answering them, but by outgrowing the floor they were asked from.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Pascagoula Landing
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the Pascagoula landing.

The group wants to know about a confrontation. Two of their people came face to face with a combatant from another planet. The transcript names it plainly. The Pascagoula landing.

Hatonn answers through an instrument who is struggling, and he asks for patience. The contact is difficult. The concepts are restricted. But what comes through is surprising in its calm.

The Pascagoula landing, he says, was not a completely isolated instance. However, it is the only instance which has been delivered into the hands of public knowledge. It is one of very few landings by that particular group.

These peoples are members of a type of combatant group. There is not the idea of soldiering or war as you know it. That is the closest interpretation your language permits. These people were interested simply as passersby in the phenomena which they saw. And not having strong enough leadership, they decided to take a closer look. There was no intention of any harm at all.

No invasion. No message. Just curiosity, and weak discipline. Passersby who stopped to stare.

It is doubtful, he says, that this type of craft and this particular group will cease passing this area of space, for reasons none of which are connected with your planet. So you may again discover evidence of such a contact. But we assure you that it is merely a rare, scattered, and unharmful confrontation.

Asked whether the beings were people or robots, he answers: these were beings with consciousness and individuality. They were, however, not precisely of the nature which you would call human. You are not at this time aware of the possibilities that exist in the creation. However, these people are not robots.

Asked what he means by combatants, he reaches for the strangest description in the session. Their world is more totally conscious of illusion than yours. Each of the difficulties of learning within their density results in an externally expressed series of movements, a highly stylized fashion of dealing with the illusion. The closest the instrument can come to explaining it is a kind of game, with much of the mental characteristics of war, but entirely mental.

They go a far distance to take part in it. And due to the structure these people have built over many generations of this discipline, the outcome of this combat will be final, just, and completely acceptable to each who depended upon it.

These people are progressing along a different path than yours. And this is true throughout the infinite creation. But they are progressing towards the same goal that we all share.

Asked how they compare to Earth in progress, he is honest about the difficulty of the comparison. But he says this. The average vibration upon that alien planet is far more advanced than the lower average of those upon planet Earth who stubbornly sleep. And yet the potential within very many of those upon planet Earth is more advanced than the basic vibratory level of the planet. As those of Earth have much potential, so they also have little time to translate their potential into actuality.

Much potential. Little time. That is the whole human situation in four words.

Asked about their senses, he says simply: they are aware. The material which covers them is aware of more than all of the physical senses upon this planet are aware of, in unison. You would call it skin.

The transcript ends there. No closing benediction, just the facts as best as a struggling instrument could carry them. Curious passersby. A mental game mistaken for war. And a reminder that the universe is larger, stranger, and less hostile than the headlines suggest.

Thank you for listening.

title: Realization Is All
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: realization is all.

The group asks the biggest question there is. What level are you on? Have you been on our level? Will we attain your level? How far are you from the final destination?

Hatonn does not dodge. He answers at length, and the answer is more humble than you might expect from a voice speaking out of the sky.

We of the Confederation have experienced the type of physical illusion you now find yourselves experiencing, he says. We sought the truth of creation through meditation. We attained a higher rate of vibration, and evolved to a greater awareness than can be attained within this illusion.

Our level of existence is one of what you would consider spiritual. It is much higher evolved than that which you are presently in. Yet the question of the attainment of the ultimate source, or union with the Creator, we cannot answer. For we have not evolved into realms higher than the one we presently occupy.

Yet we are truly aware of their existence. For in our travels we have come upon entities who availed to us truths of even a higher awareness. And they availed to us the thought of infinite levels of awareness on the path to total union with the Creator.

There is much within this creation that we do not comprehend, he says. And there is much that you do not comprehend.

We do not claim to be an ultimate source of information. We are capable of committing error. And then the warning I wish every seeker would memorize. If you encounter any entity who exclaims that he can commit no error, you should truly know that this entity has erred in that judgment. For only the Creator can function without error.

The one who claims perfection has just proved he lacks it. Remember that the next time any voice, channeled or otherwise, asks for your unquestioning trust.

Asked what life is like on his planet compared to ours, he paints the picture. At one time, he says, life on our planet was much like that upon planet Earth. But the entire population of sentient beings has developed a singular desire. It began as a simple seeking for understanding, and has grown into a completely unitary and combined ability, each brother feeling and being as one. We are now seeking as one. And our seeking has pointed directly at service. Ever expanding service. Service to all parts of the creation.

In this manner we have developed abilities you may call miraculous. We transcend what you know as time and space. We have conscious access to knowledge of which you have access only during meditation, in a subconscious manner.

The freedoms which we enjoy, my friends, are there because we have begun to see that we are all one. Realization is all that is between planet Earth and the planet Hatonn.

Realization is all. Not technology. Not time. Not distance. Just the seeing.

On your planet as on our planet, he says, each blade of grass is alive with the knowledge of the Creator. The winds sing his praises. Trees shout for joy in the creation of our infinite Father. If you are not able to see the Creator, my friends, it is a matter of seeking, and seeking, and continued seeking.

Planet Earth, he says, is indeed a lovely planet. It will soon be vibrating in a manner far more associated with realization. Begin to realize, and move with your planet, as we moved with ours.

And then, with disarming honesty, he admits they have not always succeeded elsewhere. We have aided many planets who are beginning a new phase of vibration. We have aided many a graduating class, and we have done so successfully. We have also failed, not once, but several times. It is completely possible for us to fail, because we wish to fail if it be the will of the people of the planet we are attempting to aid.

At the present time, he says, we are far behind where we had hoped to be in helping planet Earth. It is possible there will be a smaller graduation than we had hoped. However, it is our greatest pleasure to be working with those of you, however many or however few, who are seeking.

It is only necessary to seek, he says. And the spiritual path shall roll behind you, and open before you. And what you desire shall be yours.

The path rolls behind you and opens before you. You do not have to build the road. You only have to walk.

Thank you for listening.

title: Know It, Reflect It
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: know it, reflect it.

This is a short session, spoken quickly because the time is short. Hatonn says the instrument desired speed of communication, and he obliged. What comes through is compressed, but it holds one of the clearest statements in the early archive about the limits of the intellect.

Seeking takes place in many and varied ways, he says. What is important is the seeking, not its definition or its appearance. When an individual begins to seek, he will find. What he finds will seem different from what others find, in many instances. But it will only apparently be different. For there is in truth only one thing to find. And that is the love and the understanding of our Creator.

He has spoken many times about the value of meditation. And here he draws the line sharply. Intellectual understanding, which is sought and found by many upon your planet, is an indication of your progress along the path toward a total spiritual understanding. It in itself is of no real value.

What you find in your endeavors to understand within the limits of your illusion, and within the limits of your intellectual mind, is so very, very limited as to be of no real practical value.

He does not call intellectual seeking useless. Some benefit is derived in the endeavor to seek. But it is transient. It points at the path; it is not the path. What matters is a direct and simple understanding, through meditation, of the total love of the Creator. A method not relegated to the biases of the intellect.

And then the instruction, stated as simply as it can be stated. This is all that is necessary, he says. Simply know this love, and reflect it. Know it in a total sense. Do not attempt to understand it. Embrace it through meditation. And then you must reflect it in your daily existence.

Do not attempt to understand it. Embrace it. The mind wants to dissect the love. The instruction is to stop dissecting and start carrying it.

The contact breaks, resumes, and he presses the point further. There is no understanding within the intellect, he says. The understanding you seek can be found only within a much, much greater mind than your present intellectual mind.

There is a very simple way to reach the understanding you seek. This very simple way is also the very best way. It is through the process of meditation. Meditate, and it will become obvious that this is the understanding you seek.

There is no system of arrangement of words presently in your language which can define adequately the creation. There is no system of words which can tell what you will reach through the simple process of meditation.

It is understandable that at times this process seems not to be fruitful. But this, he says, is the only fruitful process in which you engage. Spend as much time as you can in availing yourself to truth through meditation. We know that this is what you desire. If we did not know this, we would not give you this information.

Know the love. Reflect the love. Everything else is commentary.

Thank you for listening.

title: Patterns in the Sky
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: patterns in the sky.

The group has seen something. A sighting. Patterns drawn in the sky. And they want to know what it was.

Hatonn answers that he is aware of one sighting with which his people had a part. The patterns were drawn by a member of the Confederation. We indulged ourselves, he says, at that particular time, for the general purpose of sending you a greeting. It is very seldom that this is possible. A specific type of attitude must have been nurtured over a fairly long period. But the attitude was present, and so we sent the greeting.

The craft, he says, was larger than the one they normally dwell in. He has difficulty transmitting numbers through the instrument, so he gives a comparison. The ship was approximately the size of more than one football field. It was above the level of the atmosphere, at the fringes of space.

Asked whether the patterns had meaning, whether they were symbolic, his answer is lovely. They were intended to be obvious, he says. And to indicate to you only that your brothers, intelligent, sentient, and very close to you, were sending greetings. Other than this, the movements were not symbolic. They were intended simply to be an obviously non-natural movement.

Not a code. Not a prophecy. A wave hello, written across the sky.

We wish that we could indulge ourselves and express our great joy at all times in greeting each of you, he says. We would do this and more, for we feel very much joy at being able to share with you our understanding and our very existence in the Father's creation. We have not found that this is possible. So we must send our greetings, our love, and our aid from the creation to your creation by these ways and means, until such time that we can be true brothers, and experience the joy of the Father's creation together in all its freedom.

Then the teaching on symbols, which is worth keeping on its own. Symbols are what you understand them to be, he says. There are no arbitrary symbols. The true symbol is that which is most real. Just as the sun is often a symbol. When the circle is seen as symbol, the circle is a representation of the sun. And the sun is a beautiful example of the unity of the creation, the light and the love at the center of the universe.

What you see as a symbol may mean this or that. The only importance in any symbol is that it points you toward your center, and toward the center of the creation. And this can be done by any symbol, by any task, as long as you turn within. If you saw a symbol in our motion, or in any other phenomena around you, then turn within, and allow that which is merely symbolic to become reality.

The symbol is not the destination. It is the finger pointing. Look where it points.

Asked about meeting face to face, he returns to the deepest teaching of the session. We are not distant wise men, he says. Nor are we advanced representatives of an invading civilization. We are you. And you are we. If you can understand that you have not met any who is not you, then you can begin to understand that when you meet us, you will be meeting yourself.

Without this understanding you will never be able to meet us. But in order to obtain it, it is necessary to meet each individual that you meet with the love, the infinite compassion, and understanding with which you would meet yourself.

It is easier to speak of meditation, he observes, than of service to those who do not seem very much like you. My friends, they are like you. In fact, they are you. And we are you, and you are we, and we are all the creation.

On the question of the coming transition, he will not give a blanket statement. Your ultimate destination is an individual matter. But he says this to the group. You have chosen right, my friends, each of you have. You have earned for yourself a strong chance of being part of the so-called graduation class. Continue, continue, and continue.

He closes with an image to carry into meditation. Imagine yourself standing on the beach, with the sun pouring down. Imagine how the gentle breezes calm you and cool you. And let the warm sun take any ache or pain from you. The love and the light of the infinite Father is like the beam of light and warmth. If you bask in it, my friends, there is the end to questions, and the beginning of true comfort.

The end of questions. The beginning of comfort. Bask a while.

Thank you for listening.

title: It Will Make No Difference
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: it will make no difference.

Hatonn wants to talk about the nature of the physical illusion, and he starts with something you may recognize from your own life. At the time each of you incarnated, he says, each of you was aware that certain lessons, hitherto unlearned, were to be the goals of this incarnation.

If it seems to you that your entire incarnation has been a series of difficulties of one particular type, then you are almost certainly aware, in some manner, of one of your lessons. As you can see, these lessons are not to be avoided. They are to be learned.

The repeating difficulty is not a curse. It is the curriculum. You signed up for this class before you got here.

Further, he says, when a confrontation in such a lesson has been achieved, that which separates you from understanding it is most often your own thinking. Your conscious thinking processes are quite capable of being self-destructive, in the sense that they may aid you to avoid the lesson you wish in reality to learn.

The mind does not want the lesson. It wants comfort. And it is very clever at manufacturing reasons to dodge what you came here to face.

So he suggests a practice. As you approach a lesson, if it is possible to achieve a temporary abeyance of the conscious, analytical processes, then you may return to the problem with a much clearer mentality. Ready to learn what you came to learn, rather than only to avoid what you came to learn.

Stop thinking about it for a while. Then look at it again. You will be surprised what you can see when the commentary goes quiet.

Then he turns to the reactions people have to their experiences. The reactions to experience, in almost every case, are based upon an intellectual understanding of the present illusion. And this understanding is totally false. It is necessary to construct a totally new base for understanding. And this is only possible through meditation.

He gives the example of the master teacher known as Jesus. Through meditation, Jesus became aware of truth. And his reactions to experience were of such a nature as to cause much concern among those who watched. They did not understand his reactions, for his reactions were based upon his understanding of truth.

His reaction was one of love. It was a reaction of love that was in no regard whatsoever to the nature of the experience. It was not the emotional love your peoples express in an attempt to indicate their conception of love. It was a simple demonstration of total concern for the fulfillment of the desire of his fellow man.

His awareness of this desire was greater than the awareness of those whom he served. He considered the spiritual growth of an individual of much greater importance than his physical well-being. For this reason his actions at times seemed in divergence with the love he brought. He was hated by many, and loved by many, many more.

Then the core instruction, stated plainly. There are but a few simple concepts necessary to understand. The eradication of the personal ego. And the desire for anything but service. This, if thoroughly understood and practiced, will result in immediate dissolution of the illusion under which you serve. And then you may serve directly in the light of your Creator.

For this is his service. This is our service. This is the original thought. This is the original creation. Each part serving all of the other parts, asking nothing, and expecting nothing, and therefore receiving everything.

And then the closing passage, one of the most beautiful in these early sessions, and the reason for tonight's title. Open your minds and your hearts to this awareness, he says. Do it through meditation. When you have become aware of this simple concept, you will have no more questions.

You will not be understood, my friends, but it will make no difference, for you will understand. You will not be loved, my friends, but this will make no difference, for you will love.

You will feel the vibrations. They will merge with the creation. Your spirit will sense in harmony with all that you experience.

Misunderstood, and it does not matter. Unloved, and it does not matter. Because the understanding and the love are no longer things you need from the world. They are things you carry.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Ocean of Love
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the ocean of love.

Hatonn opens with a question, and it is really a question for you, listening now. I wonder this evening, he says, if you have allowed yourself during this day to rest in the enormous ocean of love which is yours, if you realize it to be yours.

Have you allowed yourself to soak up the infinite light and love of your Creator during this day? Or has it been a day during which you felt some lack of this love, in which you felt separated from the sunlight and the warmth of life?

He knows the answer, for most of us, most days. The very nature of the physical illusion is such that the individual experiences many sensations of seeming separation and lack of love. But this, he says, is an illusion.

If you allow yourself through meditation to seek reality, you will quickly discover the vast and limitless ocean of love which bathes the entire creation of the Father. There is nothing but this love. Not only is it all about you, but it is you, in that each fiber of your soul and your physical being is composed of love and light.

Each fiber. Not metaphorically. You are made of the stuff you think you are missing.

The pain of lack is real in its feeling, and it is often intensified by an accompanying belief in the reality of time. When you experience illusory lack, it is very easy to assume that this lack will continue for a certain amount of time, which seems extremely long.

So the suffering has two layers. The feeling of absence, and the story that the absence will last. Both are illusion. Within meditation, he says, make contact with the timeless, the infinite, the eternal truth of creation. Discover the love and light of the Creator. It is all about you. And if you are able to make contact, it may flow to you and through you, so that you are lifted upward along the spiritual path, and are finally free of the illusion.

These experiences are necessary to you. They are your means of spiritually growing while you enjoy the physical experience. However, you need not be limited by the difficulties of this illusory existence. While you are learning, you may also go within, and speed your learning considerably by contact with all that there is.

Through another instrument comes a practical note I love. All peoples of your Earth live daily problems which are solvable in meditation. All problems can be taken to meditation. Small problems and large problems.

Most people who meditate think not to bother with small, day-to-day difficulties, and will not take them to meditation. But it is necessary that you exist from day to day. Meditation will help you in every way. Bring the small things too. Nothing is too minor for the ocean.

Then the sternest passage of the evening, and one of the most quoted lines of the early archive. The peoples of your planet have believed for many centuries that knowledge is knowledge obtained through the five physical senses. My friends, the knowledge that you presently have is of absolutely no value.

The knowledge you will gain in reading or studying or through any learning process will have only one value. That single value will be to make you aware of the need for meditation.

The most educated of the peoples of your planet know nothing of truth if they have not availed themselves to it in meditation. There is no intellectual awareness of the truth of this creation. It is something else. Something much more basic. An awareness that transcends any ability to rationalize or comprehend in an intellectual manner.

Any endeavor to comprehend truth through the use of any part of this illusion is totally of no value. We have attempted to make you aware of the possibility of awareness. This is all that we can do. We can instruct on the method. We can tell you that this is what you desire. But only you, my friends, can find it. You and you alone must make the step, the simple step of meditation each day, to arrive at the awareness that you desire.

That single thing that man throughout all of the creation desires, he says in closing. Understanding of his Creator. So that he may travel more swiftly along the path to the love and understanding that has created him.

The ocean is already around you. It is already you. All that remains is to notice.

Thank you for listening.

title: Creation of the Father
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: creation of the father.

We are in late May of nineteen seventy-four, in the earliest days of these sessions. The one who calls himself Hatonn is speaking through a small group of new instruments, and he is, by his own report, in a very good mood. As we share this fellowship, he says, our hearts are very light. We are, as you would say, very happy. And then, quietly: my friends, we are always very happy.

He poses a question, the kind of question that sounds like a riddle until you try it. Look around yourselves, he says, and ask what portion of your creation seems always to be at peace. Always happy. His answer is plain. It is the creation of the Father that remains in equilibrium, while the creation of man on Earth has many unhappy phases.

I love that he frames it as something you can test. Go somewhere remote, he says, and you will feel more peace of mind. This is a natural consequence of more exposure to the creation of the Father. But then he takes the thought further than geography. The creation is all around you no matter where you are, he says. It begins with yourself. Through meditation you may remain constantly in contact with the real creation.

And what is that contact like? He gives what may be the shortest definition in the whole archive. This happiness, he says, is simply the awareness that you are a part of all that there is. Nothing more. Listen to how he puts it: it is a simple awareness, and it defies definition of any kind. It is only in the creation of man on Earth that individuals require definitions. Definitions and distinctions and disassociations are all separations from the Creator's plan of unity.

Think about that for a moment. The mind reaches for definitions the way a hand reaches for a rail in the dark. Hatonn says the rail is part of the separation. Follow the definitions and the distinctions, and you will get exactly what they give: unhappiness. Allow yourself, through meditation, to be aware of the true creation instead, and you will feel the equilibrium of it.

And here is the part I find most striking. He refuses to push. We can only suggest this, he says. We cannot speak in such a way as to demonstrate this truth. It is completely up to you. You are a free creation, he says, an entity with a mind and will completely sovereign. It is totally within your province of choice what you wish to do with each succeeding moment of your conscious awareness within this incarnation.

Then the contact moves to another instrument, and the tone shifts from philosophy to service. We of the Confederation, he says, are here to serve, and we will do it to the very limit of our ability. But our ability is limited only by the people of planet Earth. Limited by their desire. So the contact comes in this strange, deniable form, so that those who desire our service receive it, and those who do not are not made aware of our presence at all.

Many are seeking, he says, and many are finding what they seek. The method is the one he has been pointing at all evening. It was demonstrated, he says, by the master teacher known as Jesus. His service to his fellow man was very great, and it continues even to this day. And he discovered, through meditation, the way in which he would serve.

Hatonn offers no new doctrine. He offers instructions, he says, so that the people of Earth may also discover their own service and how to perform it, simply through the process of daily meditation. Spend time in meditation, he says, and in this way and in only this way will you realize the truth of the creation and understand your part in its workings. This, he says, will result in a state of ecstasy which we cannot describe.

His last thought of the evening is about time. What you obtain in the physical illusion, he says, is yours for a very short time. But the strides that you are able to make on your spiritual path will last throughout eternity. You will never need to take these steps again.

A resting thought. The Father's creation does not need your definitions, your systems, or your permission. It only asks for your attention. And meditation is how you give it.

Thank you for listening.

title: Possession by Self
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: possession by self.

It is the evening of May twenty-eighth, nineteen seventy-four, and the group brings Hatonn a question born of honest fear. They want to know about possession. They are opening themselves to voices not their own, and they want to know: can something get in? Hatonn's answer is gentle, strange, and far more useful than the question expected.

First, he says, you have nothing to fear if you understand what possession actually is. There are two types, he says. The first is the one everyone pictures. The actual possession of one sentient being's physical vehicle by the consciousness of another. It is, he says, extremely rare, for two reasons. There are not many entities looking for a vehicle that is not theirs. And the dissociation of consciousness required to make an opening has to be extreme.

Even in that rare case, he says, it can be dealt with. The original entity need only be alerted, in whatever ritual his own culture understands, and then assert his rightful ownership. The possessing entity must depart. The vehicle belongs to its owner by sovereign right. That is the whole of the first type, and Hatonn spends very little time on it. The second type is where he lingers.

The second type of possession is as common as the first is rare. It is the possession of the balanced individual consciousness by certain portions of that same consciousness. Listen to how he puts it. There are many phases of desire with which you came to this incarnation, and it is the great lesson of your ancient teachers that you must know yourself. When your desires are not recognized by you, when you have overlooked a portion of your total self, these frustrated portions may loosen from their integrated place and attempt to attract your attention in ways you do not understand.

They may attract your attention by causing pain, he says. This always attracts attention. And very often, when there are persons of the consciousness that have not been heard, they become heard in this way. This is possession by self. I love that phrase. Possession by self. The ghost in your house is you, knocking from a room you forgot to open.

The treatment, he says, is understanding. The more you can discover what lies behind the pain, the more you may remove the pain. In truth, he says, it is all, shall we say, in your mind. Therefore it is necessary to investigate your mind. There you will find your possessing, and by understanding the message brought by these subconscious means you may redirect your thought to a more positive and upward path.

Someone asks what he means by dissociation. He says the word is not quite right, only the closest the instrument had. He means a unit of individualized consciousness with such a mismatching in its own vibration that it temporarily cannot function as a unified portion of consciousness. A chord gone out of tune with itself.

And then the question that matters most for all of us. You said to take our problems to meditation. Do we sit and think about the problem, or ask and then clear the mind? Neither, he says. It is not necessary to ask for information in meditation, nor to concentrate on the problem. Meditation is the transfer of your consciousness from the phase of existence within your physical illusion to the phase of consciousness within the love and the light of the infinite Creator.

This contact gives a general and non-analyzable understanding, he says. And when problems are seen in the light of this understanding, they will most often evaporate naturally, as dew evaporates. He is careful about this image. It is not that the dew is unreal, he says. It is simply one state within a perfectly reasonable cycle that gives life and nourishment. Your problems are not to be despised, nor given more importance than they deserve. Given room to mature and evaporate, they will.

A resting thought. The thing you fear moving into your house may only be the part of you that you have not yet invited to sit down. Meditate, and listen for the knock.

Thank you for listening.

title: You Receive What You Desire
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: you receive what you desire.

It is the last evening of May, nineteen seventy-four, and Hatonn speaks through the instrument known as Don on a single word. Desire. He calls it the key to what you receive. If you desire it, he says, you shall receive it. This was the Creator's plan: that all of His parts would receive exactly what they desire.

He knows how this sounds. He knows that in the illusion you now experience, it often seems you do not acquire what you desire. In fact, exactly the opposite seems to be the case. It is a paradox, he admits. And yet, he states without exception, man receives exactly what he desires.

Perhaps, he says, you do not understand desire. Perhaps this understanding is not within the intellectual mind. Perhaps it will be necessary to spend time in meditation to become aware of your real desire. For there is much, much more of you and of the creation than you presently appreciate with your intellectual abilities.

Creation operates on a very simple method, he says. It is up to man to learn what he has forgotten. And the knowing he speaks of is not an intellectual understanding. It is a simple knowing, as natural as a sense, that is within all of the Creator's children. Expand this awareness, he says. Become in a state of knowing, so that you understand your desires.

He apologizes for the language itself. We are very limited, he says, for we cannot use the language of your people to express the truth of the mechanics of these comments. They are, I can assure you, extremely simple. But they are much broader and much farther reaching and much more elementary than anything you appreciate in your present state. The words are a narrow pipe for a wide water.

It is very difficult for the peoples of this planet to give up their illusion, he says, to give up their preconceived knowledge of cause and effect. But this is not reality. This is illusion born of illusion, a product of the complexity man has generated. Join with us, he says, in divorcing your thinking from such complexities, and become aware of what has created you.

Then comes the turn that makes the evening. Become aware of your Creator's desire, he says, and when you know this desire, you will know your own, for you and your Creator are one. When you know His desire you will feel it. There will be no more confusion, no more questions. You will have found what you sought. You will have found love. For this is the desire of your Creator: that all of His parts express and experience the love that created you.

And this may be found, he says, simply, in meditation. No amount of seeking within intellectual concepts, no planning or careful interpretation of the written or spoken word, will lead you to the simple truth. It is you, and it is all about you. It expresses itself in every living thing, constantly and unceasingly. It shouts at you, he says, from every blade of grass and from every animal and bird, from all of your fellow beings, in a terrific crescendo of love. And yet man upon Earth is blind and is deaf to these sights and these sounds.

The contact passes to another instrument, who continues on the same thread. The people of your planet, though many are not aware of it, all desire the love of the Creator. But the experiences of this illusion are presented to you, he says, for the purpose of testing your seeking of this love. And the confusion of this illusion has penetrated the intellect, so the teachings of the great teachers have been misunderstood. They all said to seek within. That is to be considered the Kingdom of Heaven.

Hatonn closes through Carla with a question to carry home. What do you seek, my friends? If you can describe what you are seeking, he says, we are afraid you are still within the material illusion. Remember that what you truly seek is not material or illusory, but is real and eternal. And then the line I will not forget. We are invaded, he says, and we are battling, seeking to conquer this planet by love.

A resting thought. Desire is not the wanting you feel in your mind. It is the current underneath it, the one that carries you whether you name it or not. Meditate, and find out which way it is flowing.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Advertisement
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the advertisement.

It is the first evening of June, nineteen seventy-four. Hatonn opens with a strange confession. He is speaking from a craft far above the place of dwelling, and he is able to monitor the group's thoughts. He knows how this sounds. But I can assure you, he says, that it is not an infringement. Our capabilities are not designed to infringe upon thinking or activities. And then the reason. We do not consider the knowledge of the thoughts of others to be an infringement, for we see these thoughts as our own. We see these thoughts as the thoughts of the Creator.

He extends this further than most listeners would be comfortable with. It may seem, he says, that thinking of a nature other than love and brotherhood could not be generated by the Creator.
